confirmed.title: Backspace 'reset' teleports the player to their spawn point at any time inside a raid
confirmed.detail: main._unhandled_input handles the 'reset' action (Backspace, bound unconditionally in _setup_input) with player.force_ground() plus global_position = level.spawn_point(). Nothing gates it for the new maps: it is not test-mode-only and is not checked against downed, boss or PvP state. ex_hud only swallows keys while the bag or result page is open. ExLevel.spawn_point() returns the spawn picked once at entry, so the jump is always to that fixed point. It skips the cave links (no layer/lighting switch), the sandstorm boundary, boss leash rules and the doctor follow rules. force_ground() does not clear _downed, so a downed player also escapes the finishing blow and keeps the 20 s timer.
confirmed.trigger: Desktop raid in desert: get downed by an enemy player, or get chased near the 凌幽 arena, then press Backspace. You land instantly at your corner spawn, still alive. It also works from the underground cave straight back to the surface.
confirmed.fix: In main._unhandled_input, change the reset branch to `elif e.is_action_pressed("reset"): if _ex_mode() and not preload("res://scripts/raid_profile.gd").test_mode(): return`, then do the existing teleport. Alternatively, skip it whenever level != null and level.raid is running. Keep it for the legacy and test paths.
confirmed.evidence: scripts/main.gd:654-664: the refactor added `var gm := test_mode() and not _ex_mode()` and gated realm_prev/realm_next and the number keys with it, but the `reset` branch at main.gd:662-664 is still unconditional: it calls player.force_ground() and sets global_position = level.spawn_point(). In ex mode `level` is the ExLevel (main.gd:934), and ExLevel.spawn_point() at ex_level.gd:99-101 returns the fixed entry spawn. Nothing swallows Backspace in a raid: ex_hud._input (ex_hud.gd:653-675) only eats Tab/B/Esc, and eats other keys only while _modal() (the bag) is open. player.force_ground() (player.gd:942-950) does not touch _downed, so a downed player is moved away while still downed, and the 20 s timer and self-revive keep working. One sub-claim is wrong: the layer is NOT skipped. ex_level._process (ex_level.gd:568-570) re-derives layer_of(player pos) every frame and calls _set_layer, and W_maps.md:183 documents this for Backspace. The core exploit is still real: on desktop you can teleport out of PvP, out of boss fights, out of a finishing blow while downed, or out of the cave.

confirmed.title: Key-room boxes can be looted again without a key by anyone who joins or re-joins while the door is open
confirmed.detail: Key-room boxes are meant to refill only when the door is opened (_box_opened returns true for room boxes until _door_apply). Three pieces break that. (1) net_ex_sync applies box times first, then calls _door_apply(id, true, t) for every open door. _door_apply(open) sets t = -INF on every box in that room, so the joiner sees all of them as fresh. (2) The host's net._ex_box_judge uses the 180 s EX_BOX_CD for every box, room boxes included, so it grants any room box opened 180 s or more ago. _ex_sync_req also leaves those boxes out of the sync. (3) The 'reopen because I'm still inside' branch in net_ex_door (line 1914) also calls _door_apply(id, true, ...), which refills every box in the room on that machine. It broadcasts open with refill=[], so the other machines refill locally too.
confirmed.trigger: Lab, LAN. A opens K1 with a key at room time T and loots its 3 boxes, then extracts and re-matches into the same room (or B joins) after T+180 while the door is still open (900 s). net_ex_sync refills K1's boxes on the joiner. The joiner opens each one, the host judge sees more than 180 s and grants, and the joiner rolls labLockedSupplyBox (4 draws) again with no key. This repeats on every re-join.
confirmed.fix: 1) In _door_apply add a `refill: bool` parameter. Refill boxes only in _door_read (a real key use). In net_ex_door, refill only the indices in the received _refill list. In net_ex_sync, apply doors with refill=false and apply boxes after the doors. In the 'still inside' re-open branch, do not refill. 2) In net.gd, keep room boxes out of the EX_BOX_CD rule: _ex_box_judge should deny any room box present in _ex_boxes regardless of age, since _ex_log_door erases it on a real refill. To do that the host needs to know which box indices are room boxes, for example by sending a flag with ex_box_claim or by tracking ids in _ex_log_door. _ex_sync_req should then send room-box entries regardless of age.
confirmed.evidence: extract_manager.gd:1774-1779: room boxes count as opened until a door refill (`if room != "": return true`). net_ex_sync (extract_manager.gd:3575-3584) applies box times first and then calls _door_apply(id, true, t) for every open door. _door_apply (1891-1906) sets b.t = -INF on every box in that room, so a joiner always sees every room box as fresh. On top of that, net._ex_sync_req (net.gd:1143-1151) only sends boxes newer than EX_BOX_CD (180 s), and net._ex_box_judge (net.gd:981-993) grants any box older than 180 s, room boxes included. KEY_ROOM_T is 900 s (extract_manager.gd:61), so a door stays open long after its boxes pass 180 s. A non-host who extracts leaves the room (main.gd:1027-1032 calls net.leave) and can re-match into the same room, where manager _ready calls ex_sync_req (847-848). They, or any mid-raid joiner, can then reopen every looted room box with no key, and the host grants it. Branch (3), net_ex_door at 1909-1916, also really calls _door_apply(open), refilling locally and broadcasting refill=[] so the host does not erase _ex_boxes. That branch only fires on a position-lag edge, because _update_doors (1941-1947) already checks remote positions before closing.

confirmed.title: A second copy of a boss can be spawned, and _adopt_boss orphans the live local boss: duplicated boss drops and 仙玉
confirmed.detail: _update_bosses spawns a normal boss as soon as the local player is within 110 m and _boss_alive(b) is false. A remote owner's boss only counts once its puppet exists. net_mob_apply builds at most 3 puppets per batch, and _my_mobs lists bosses after all regular mobs, so the boss puppet can arrive several 100 ms batches late. _saw_boss only frees my copy if it is fresh (under 3 s, full HP) and the other owner's id is lower. Otherwise both copies live. When a puppet is created, _adopt_boss overwrites b.node with the puppet unconditionally. The owner's real boss then drops out of _my_mobs, so it is no longer batched or findable by net_find_mob, but it keeps fighting and keeps its died->_on_boss_died binding. If the other copy is later freed, the stale puppet makes _update_bosses spawn a third one. Every copy that is killed rolls the full drop table and pays XIANYU_BOSS.
confirmed.trigger: Desert LAN. Player A (id 5) is fighting 绛罗. Player B (id 1) drops through pit U2, whose cave exit is 81.6 m from 绛罗's spawn (measured from MapDef). Within 0.4 s B's _update_bosses spawns its own 绛罗 before A's puppet batch lands, since A's wraith adds take the first 3 puppet slots. On A's machine, B's puppet overwrites A's boss reference and A's real boss becomes an orphan. Both bosses can then be killed for 2×16 superBossDrops1 items and 2×5 仙玉. Lab: stair exit u4 is 109 m from 凌影, so it works there too. Two players pressing the summon altar in the same ~100 ms also triggers it.
confirmed.fix: In _adopt_boss, if b's slot already holds a valid non-puppet node, resolve deterministically. If my id < owner_id, queue_free the incoming puppet, remove it from _puppets and keep mine; the other side will free its copy. If my id > owner_id, free my real copy (or hand over its HP), drop its died binding, then adopt. Apply this regardless of engagement, and also in _saw_boss. Delay normal-boss spawning for about 1 s after a teleport, join or layer change. Also put boss entries first in net_mob_batch (or exempt lair>=0 entries from the 3-per-batch puppet cap), so puppets arrive before the 0.4 s tick. Route summons through the host, the same way as boxes.
confirmed.evidence: extract_manager.gd:3077-3078: _update_bosses (every 0.4 s, 1043-1048) spawns when st==0, d < BOSS_SPAWN_R (110) and not _boss_alive(b). A remote owner's boss only counts once its puppet exists. net_mob_apply (2703-2758) creates at most 3 new puppets per 10 Hz batch (`if fresh >= 3: continue`, net.gd:35 MOB_HZ=10), and _my_mobs (2668-2675) puts bosses after all of _mobs, so the boss puppet can lag several batches. The race is real on a link teleport: the desert U2 pit is at surface x=-228 and its cave exit is at x=772 (map_def.gd:117,183, D_CAV=1000), while 绛罗 is at dc(161,8,481) = (860,15,36). That is about 88 m from the exit and about 1088 m from the pit, so no puppet existed before the jump. _saw_boss (2934-2943) only frees my copy if the other id is lower AND my copy is fresh (<3 s, full HP), so an engaged boss never yields. _adopt_boss (2925-2931) overwrites b[node] with the incoming puppet unconditionally. The real local boss then drops out of _my_mobs, stops being batched, and is unreachable by net_find_mob, but it keeps fighting and keeps its died->_on_boss_died(b, sub) binding (2975). That handler rolls the full drop table, pays XIANYU_BOSS and sets b[node]=null (3091-3122). If the other machine's puppet then goes stale (raid_mob.gd:698-701, 1.5 s), _boss_alive is false again and a further copy spawns. _summon (3082-3088) uses only local state, so two near-simultaneous altar presses also duplicate.

confirmed.title: On death only equipped 法宝 are dropped; 法宝 carried in the bag survive (SPEC says they always drop)
confirmed.detail: death_drops removes the sellable stacks, then loops only over equip.chip. Chip items sitting in the raid bag are kept and returned to the profile by end_raid(ok=false), and also by _recover_live after a crash. SPEC 3.4 says 法宝 are always lost on death, and SPEC 4.6.3 says all 法宝 drop with their current durability. Chips are not sellables, so the 2-stack rule does not touch them, and ExData.can_sell is true for them (trader value = base × durability). Verified headless: an equipped c_regen_4 was dropped, while a c_regen_4 in the bag (value 25000, can_sell=true) stayed in the bag after death_drops.
confirmed.trigger: Loot a 法宝 from a 兵器匣 or a boss and leave it in the bag (or unequip all chips before a risky fight), then die. The relic chest has no 法宝, and the chips come home and can be sold or equipped.
confirmed.fix: In death_drops, after the equip loop, walk the bag backwards and move every item with kind=='chip' into `chips` (bag.remove_at). Both the relic chest path and _recover_live then pick it up automatically. Also consider listing bag chips in result.lost.
confirmed.evidence: ex_data.gd:1377-1409: death_drops takes only sellables (is_sellable = kind sell/tag, 1132-1134) from the bag. The chip loop at 1401-1408 iterates equip.chip only. A kind=='chip' item in the bag stays in `bag`. extract_manager.gd:1575 and ex_profile.gd:171 (_recover_live) both use this function, and end_raid (ex_profile.gd:655-662) only clears equip.chip when lost_chips is set, so bag chips go home. SPEC.md:128 (3.4 法宝) says '死亡必掉' and SPEC.md:242 (4.6.3) says '法宝全掉（带当前耐久）'. The 4.6.4 keep-list (兵刃 / 法衣 / 药 / 符 / 钥匙) does not include 法宝.

confirmed.title: A host re-entering its own kept room never restores room state: boss cooldowns, door state and doctor rescue are bypassed
confirmed.detail: Only non-hosts call ex_sync_req. When the host extracts while others stay in the room, main keeps the room (net.keep_room). The host's next _enter_level re-uses that room, so a fresh manager is built with every boss in state 0, every door closed and _doc_cycle_done = -1. net._ex_bosses, _ex_doors and _ex_doc, which are exactly what a joiner would receive, are never applied locally. Results: (a) a boss killed seconds ago, on a 500–600 s respawn or summon cooldown, respawns as soon as the host walks within 110 m, with full drops and 仙玉. (b) The host sees open key rooms as closed solid doors, a desync. (c) If the doctor was already rescued this cycle (_ex_doc state 3, holder 0), the host's manager spawns a new doctor once day_sec passes the schedule. _ex_doc_judge accepts the claim because holder is 0, so the host can extract with him again for +1,000,000 灵石 and +20 仙玉.
confirmed.trigger: Lab LAN, 2 players. The host kills 电鞭铁卫, extracts (room kept because the client is still inside), immediately re-enters lab and walks to 百炼坊: the boss is there again and drops another 16 items. The same loop repeats doctor rescues within one day cycle.
confirmed.fix: Fix rules-2 first, since net_ex_sync currently refills room boxes. Then in manager _ready, when net_on() and net.is_host, call net._ex_tab() and apply the host's own tables locally through the same path (add net.ex_local_sync(raid) that builds the dictionaries _ex_sync_req builds and calls raid.net_ex_sync). For the doctor, store the cycle number in _ex_doc, so a state-3 entry only blocks its own cycle, and pass that cycle through net_ex_doc_owner instead of using _doc_cycle() blindly.
confirmed.evidence: extract_manager.gd:847: only `not net.is_host` calls ex_sync_req. main._return_to_hall (main.gd:1027-1030) calls net.keep_room() when the host leaves while others remain. main._enter_level (889-897) puts the host back into that same room (own_room), and a fresh ExLevel/manager is built. net._ex_bosses, _ex_doors and _ex_doc survive, since _ex_tab (net.gd:951-958) only clears on a seed change, but nothing applies them on the host. The new manager has every boss in state 0, so _update_bosses (3077-3078) spawns a boss that is still on cooldown as soon as the host comes within 110 m. Clients adopt its puppet (_adopt_boss sets state 1), and its death pays drops plus XIANYU_BOSS again. Doors show closed on the host. _doc_cycle_done is -1, so _update_doctor_spawn (3402-3424) spawns the doctor again in the same cycle after it was rescued. _ex_doc_judge (net.gd:1085-1091) only refuses when state==2, so a state-3 entry passes. The host can escort him again for DOCTOR_LINGSHI plus XIANYU_DOCTOR (_extract_done 1531-1538).

confirmed.title: Shell, chip wear, PvP burst budget and the 'hurt' flag are charged before block, dodge or parry is resolved
confirmed.detail: to_player_from (bound as every mob's and boss's atk_out) calls _absorb_shell on the full PvE value and sets _hurt_mark before raid_mob or ExBoss calls player.melee/air.receive_attack. receive_attack then returns -1 for dodge i-frames, airborne, DOWN or EXECUTE states, 2 for a parry, or applies only CS.BLOCK_CHIP (15%) when blocking. net_take_hit (from>0) does the same: _pvp_clamp budget, _absorb_shell, ExData.wear_chips and _hurt_mark all run on the pre-block value before receive_attack. Raid_mob._hit_player also calls atk_out when the player is in FLY/DIVE, where the hit is ignored (res -1).
confirmed.trigger: Hold 护体 against a 12-pt lab zombie hit with 12 玄龟镜 shell: the whole shell is consumed for a hit that would have chipped 1.8. Or perfectly dodge or parry a mob swing while standing in an extraction zone (or during the 1.5 s box channel): _hurt_mark cancels the extraction or box read even though no damage was taken. In PvP, a blocked 22-pt hit still wears equipped 法宝 by 220 durability.
confirmed.fix: In atk_out, apply only the armor multiplier. Move shell absorption, chip wear, the pvp_clamp charge and _hurt_mark to after receive_attack, driven by the return code (0 = full hit, 1 = blocked chip, -1/2 = nothing) or by the hp delta (hp_before - melee.hp). Because receive_attack applies dmg itself, the clean way is to pre-subtract the shell only for res==0 by passing a callback, or to restore hp by the absorbed amount after the call. For FLY/DIVE in raid_mob._hit_player, skip atk_out entirely.
confirmed.evidence: raid_mob.gd:866-883 (_hit_player) calls atk_out before choosing receive_attack, and still calls it when player.st is FLY or DIVE (res stays -1). ex_boss.gd:436-452 (_hit) also calls atk_out first. to_player_from (extract_manager.gd:1090-1096) calls _absorb_shell on the full value and sets _hurt_mark = true. player_melee.receive_attack (player_melee.gd:990-1015) then returns -1 for DOWN, EXECUTE, airborne or dodge_iframes, returns 2 on a parry, and on a block only takes dmg*CS.BLOCK_CHIP. In PvP, net_take_hit (1239-1251) runs _pvp_clamp (burst budget), _absorb_shell, ExData.wear_chips and _hurt_mark before receive_attack (1258-1262). So a 12-pt hit into a block with 12 shell burns all the shell, leaving 0 to chip (it should have been 1.8). A parried or dodged swing sets _hurt_mark, which cancels the extract channel (_update_extract 1486-1491) and any box or med channel (_update_channel 1310-1312). A blocked PvP hit still wears chips at 10 per point.

confirmed.title: Standing in an extraction zone silently blocks medicine use and teammate revive
confirmed.detail: _update_extract starts an 'extract' channel in _ch every frame the player is in a zone (not downed, not hurt). ui_use for med returns early when _ch is not empty, and ui_card 'r:' only begins revive_mate when _ch is empty. Neither gives any feedback. A hit clears the channel for one frame and it restarts the next. So inside any extraction zone a player cannot heal or start reviving a downed teammate. The only way out is to leave the zone, and the downed mate may be lying inside it.
confirmed.trigger: LAN duo: the teammate is downed inside a desert extraction ring (a typical camping spot). You walk up with 强心丹, the 'revive' card appears, and pressing T or clicking does nothing. Five seconds later you extract alone. Using 金疮药 in the ring also does nothing.
confirmed.fix: In ui_use (med) and ui_card ('r', and 'b'/'k' for consistency), if _ch.kind == 'extract', call _cancel_channel() and then start the requested channel. _update_extract already treats any non-extract channel as `busy` (1480), so it pauses the passive extraction until that channel ends. Alternatively show a toast such as '撤离读条中' instead of failing silently.
confirmed.evidence: _update_extract (extract_manager.gd:1478-1505) calls _begin_channel("extract", ...) whenever _ch is empty and the player is inside a zone, not downed and not hurt. A hit clears it (1486-1491) and it restarts on the next frame. ui_use 'med' returns silently when `not _ch.is_empty()` (2089-2090). This blocks even instant meds, because the check runs before the use_t<=0.05 branch. ui_card 'r' begins revive_mate only `if _ch.is_empty()` (2066-2068), also silently. 'b' and 'k' are gated the same way. So inside any extraction ring you cannot heal or start reviving a downed mate, and there is no feedback.

confirmed.title: Doctor ownership goes stale (nightfall, or holder disconnect) and the doctor becomes unrescuable for everyone
confirmed.detail: (1) Nightfall: the night branch of _update_doctor_spawn vanishes the doctor and clears _doc_holder locally on each machine but never sends ex_doc_state, so the host's net._ex_doc stays {holder: X, state: 2}. On the next day cycle every claim reaches _ex_doc_judge, which returns silently because holder X is still in players with state 2. Nobody, X included, can rescue him while X stays in the room. A joiner during that next day, before the scheduled spawn, gets doc {X, 2} in net_ex_sync, and net_ex_doc_owner spawns a phantom doctor following X. (2) Holder disconnect or crash: _die('room_lost') or closing the game cannot send the release. The host drops X from players, but every other client keeps _doc_holder = X. _update_cards only offers the 'doc' card when _doc_holder == 0, so the doctor stands frozen at X's last position until night.
confirmed.trigger: Lab LAN room that lives past room time 1200 (people keep re-matching into it). Player X rescues the doctor at about 250 s and is still walking him to an extraction ring at 600 s, when night falls. The next day at about 1400 s the doctor reappears, and every 营救 click is ignored. Or: X holds the doctor and Alt-F4s, and the other players never see the 营救 card again that day.
confirmed.fix: Host-authoritative reset: in the night branch, if net_on() and net.is_host, call net.ex_doc_state(0, 0, pos), or have the host set _ex_doc = {} on nightfall. Better, store the day-cycle number in _ex_doc and have _ex_doc_judge treat an entry from a previous cycle as free. Connect net.roster_changed in the manager: on the host, if _ex_doc.holder is no longer in players, broadcast ex_doc_state(0, 1, last pos); on clients, net_ex_doc_owner with holder 0 already clears the hold. In net_ex_sync, do not spawn a following doctor for a holder who is not in net.players.
confirmed.evidence: Night branch at _update_doctor_spawn (extract_manager.gd:3406-3417): it vanishes the doctor, sets _doc_holder = 0 and _doc_cycle_done, and sends nothing (no _doc_net_state). The host's net._ex_doc stays {holder: X, state: 2}. Every later claim goes through _ex_doc_judge (net.gd:1085-1089), which returns silently while `h != 0 and players.has(h) and state == 2`. If X is the host (id 1, always in players), the doctor is unrescuable for the rest of the room's life, including for X. A joiner's net_ex_sync passes doc {X,2}, and net_ex_doc_owner (3492-3517) spawns a doctor and calls _doc_take(X), giving a phantom follower. For holder disconnect: other clients keep _doc_holder = X, and nothing in the manager reacts to the roster (net.gd:416-422 only drops the remote node). The 'doc' card needs _doc_holder == 0 (2004-2007) and _doc_rescue needs it too (3436), so the doctor stands still until night. _exit_tree (965-975) does not release him either, so a graceful quit also leaves the hold stale. The doctor window is day sec 180-300 (DOCTOR_WIN, line 93) with night at 600, so being caught by nightfall while escorting happens naturally.

confirmed.title: Live-lock sync is throttled to 2 s, so an item dropped for a teammate just before quitting is duplicated on the next boot
confirmed.detail: A crash or quit is settled from ExProfile.live (the last sync_live snapshot) by _recover_live, which returns everything except 2 random sellable stacks and the equipped chips. ui_drop only sets _sync_dirty, and the sync waits until _sync_wait (SYNC_MIN 2 s since the previous sync) runs out. An item dropped within 2 s of the previous sync (another drop or pickup) is therefore still in the saved live bag while it already sits on the ground as a shared drop. Weapons, armor, keys, meds and (see rules-4) bag chips always survive _recover_live.
confirmed.trigger: LAN duo. A picks up something (sync runs), then within 2 s drops a 天启 法宝 or a weapon next to B, who claims it. A closes the game about 1 s later. On restart _recover_live gives A the item back, and B extracts with the same item.
confirmed.fix: Call ExProfile.sync_live(bag, equip) synchronously in ui_drop, before _drop_item, and anywhere else items leave the bag to become shared (throwing, chest spills). Reset _sync_wait afterwards. Pickups can stay throttled, since a stale snapshot there only loses items and does not duplicate them.
confirmed.evidence: ui_drop (extract_manager.gd:2192-2213) removes the item from the bag and creates a shared drop at once (_drop_item, then _reg_drop, then net.send_drop, 2239-2247), but it only sets _sync_dirty. The live snapshot is written only when `_sync_t <= 0 or (_sync_dirty and _sync_wait <= 0)` (1034-1039), and _sync_wait is reset to SYNC_MIN = 2.0 after every sync. So a drop within 2 s of a previous sync (a pickup, or a first drop) is not in ExProfile.live yet. Neither a quit nor _exit_tree (965-975) syncs. On the next boot _recover_live (ex_profile.gd:163-189) restores the live bag minus 2 random sellable stacks and the equipped chips, so a dropped weapon, armor, key, med or bag chip comes back while a teammate claims and extracts the same item. This is a deliberate-exploit window with a cost: 5000 灵石 and 2 sell stacks.

confirmed.title: Self-revive channel keeps running after a teammate revives you and wastes a 强心丹
confirmed.detail: _rise (called from net_ex_revive) does not cancel an in-progress 'revive_self' channel. _update_channel only cancels revive_self on a hit; the downed check exempts it. When the 3 s channel completes, _channel_done takes one revive from the bag first and then calls _rise(), which returns immediately because the player is no longer downed.
confirmed.trigger: LAN: you are downed, press 自救, and a teammate's 3 s revive finishes 1 s earlier. You stand up, and 2 s later another 强心丹 (trader value 10,000) disappears from the bag.
confirmed.fix: In _rise(), if _ch.kind == 'revive_self', call _cancel_channel(). In _channel_done 'revive_self', check player.is_downed() before take_id.
confirmed.evidence: _rise (extract_manager.gd:1170-1182), called from net_ex_revive (3590-3592), does not touch _ch. _update_channel (1304-1336) only cancels revive_self on `hurt`. The downed check exempts revive_self (1313), and the move check skips it (1316). _rise sets _last_hp = HP_MAX, so no hurt is detected. When the 3 s channel completes, _channel_done 'revive_self' (1346-1348) calls ExData.take_id(bag, 'revive', 1) first and then _rise(), which returns immediately because the player is no longer downed. One 强心丹 is lost, and other channels stay blocked for the rest of the 3 s.

confirmed.title: A claimed shared drop is destroyed for everyone if the grant arrives after the claimer extracted or died
confirmed.detail: net_granted only adds the item to the bag when 'mine and running'. Otherwise it still erases the drop and queue_frees it. The host has already marked the nid as claimed, so the item is gone everywhere. ui_card 'd:' and pick_up are allowed during the extraction channel, so a claim sent in the last frames of the 5 s extract, or just before a lethal hit, loses the item.
confirmed.trigger: LAN: in the extraction ring at 4.95/5.0 s you press T on a sell stack the host spilled there. _extract_done runs first, the grant arrives one RTT later, running is false, and the item vanishes for all players.
confirmed.fix: In net_granted, when mine and not running, re-drop the items as a new shared drop at pk's position (_drop_item / _drop_chest with a fresh nid) instead of discarding them. Alternatively, refuse new claims once extract_k > 0.9 or while a death is pending.
confirmed.evidence: net_granted (extract_manager.gd:2365-2381) erases _drops[nid] and calls queue_free on the pickup in every case, and only adds the items when `mine and running`. pick_up/_claim (2304-2309, 2254-2258) can be started from ui_card 'd:' during the extract channel, because 'd:' does not check _ch (2045-2048). If _extract_done (running=false, 1524-1527) or death happens before the grant returns, the host has already marked the nid as claimed, every peer frees the drop, and the claimer adds nothing. The item is destroyed. On LAN the window is one RTT plus a frame, so this is rare.

confirmed.title: The owner's own talismans (and AI allies) damage a boss from outside its arena, bypassing ExBoss.accept_hit
confirmed.detail: _area_damage calls n.net_damage on the owner's own mobs. raid_mob.net_damage goes straight to _take_raw: only filter_damage runs, not brain.accept_hit. AI 道友 hits go through sim_damage, which skips it as well. Remote players' talismans are checked in net_mob_take, but the owner's are not. The boss also never targets the thrower, because ExBoss only attacks players inside the arena. This breaks SPEC 8's rule that hitting a boss from outside the arena does nothing, whenever a teammate keeps the boss engaged so it does not reset.
confirmed.trigger: Lab: a teammate stands inside 电鞭铁卫's arena. The boss owner hovers just outside the platform's pad and spams 天雷符 (40 pts each) and 火符 into the boss with zero risk.
confirmed.fix: In _area_damage (and in the fire tick that shares it), for a non-puppet Mob whose brain has accept_hit, skip it unless brain.accept_hit(player.global_position) is true, matching what net_mob_take does for remote throwers. Apply the same check to AI-ally damage into bosses if that path also bypasses _take.
confirmed.evidence: _area_damage (extract_manager.gd:2467-2490) calls n.net_damage on the owner's own non-puppet mobs, bosses included through _enemies/_my_mobs (2432-2444). raid_mob.net_damage (raid_mob.gd:680-683) goes to _take_raw, which runs only filter_damage (790-791). Only _take (783-786) asks brain.accept_hit. Remote throwers are checked in net_mob_take (extract_manager.gd:2805-2808). ExBoss.accept_hit is in_arena(p, HIT_PAD=2) (ex_boss.gd:287-288, 33). So the boss owner can hit the boss with 天雷符 and 火符 from outside the arena (THROW_RANGE 14 m) while a teammate inside keeps it engaged.

confirmed.title: Two players opening the same key-room door at nearly the same time both lose a 禁室玉钥
confirmed.detail: Door opening has no host arbitration. Each machine runs its own 2 s channel and _door_read only checks its local door_is_open(id) before take_id(bag,'key',1). If both channels finish within one network latency, both keys are consumed and both broadcast open. Keys cost 60 仙玉 on the black market.
confirmed.trigger: LAN duo: both stand at K4's open_at and press the door card within about 100 ms of each other. Both keys are consumed for one door.
confirmed.fix: Arbitrate through the host like boxes: send ex_door_claim(id), have the host judge it against _ex_doors, and broadcast the open to everyone. Only the granted opener consumes a key, in the grant handler; a refused claim shows '门已经开了'.
confirmed.evidence: _door_read (extract_manager.gd:1874-1888) checks only the local door_is_open(id), consumes the key with ExData.take_id(bag, 'key', 1), and then broadcasts net.ex_door. The host does no arbitration (net.gd:1002-1023 just logs and relays). If two players' 2 s door channels finish within one network latency of each other, both pass the local check and both lose a key. A channel that finishes after the other player's broadcast has arrived is safe, because the door_is_open early return comes before take_id. The window is only RTT plus a frame, so this is rare.

confirmed.title: A late joiner sees every box in an open key room as full and can loot it a second time
confirmed.detail: `net_ex_sync` applies the host's box timestamps first (line 3579) and then calls `_door_apply(id, true, t)` for each open door (line 3583). `_door_apply(open=true)` always refills: it sets `t = -INF` on every box in that room (lines 1899-1903), which wipes the box states it just applied. On top of that, the host only sends box entries newer than `EX_BOX_CD` (net.gd `_ex_sync_req`, line 1149), and its judge expires every entry after 180 s (`_ex_box_judge`, line 983). But key-room boxes are only supposed to refill when the door is opened again (`_box_opened` line 1778). So a joiner sees all of an open room's boxes as full. For boxes opened more than 180 s ago the host approves the claim and the joiner rolls the locked table again. The `net_ex_door` 'I am still inside' branch (lines 1912-1916) and the plain open branch (line 1921) reach the same refill when a re-open broadcast with an empty refill list arrives, so the close/re-open race at the 900 s mark can also reset room boxes.
confirmed.trigger: Lab room. Player A opens K3 with a key at room time 100 and loots its 3 boxes by 110. Player C matchmakes in at room time 400 while the door is still open (900 s window). C's sync omits the K3 boxes (age 290 s, over 180) and then the door entry refills them. C walks in, sees 3 full boxes, channels 1.5 s each, and the host approves every claim because 400-110 ≥ 180. C gets 3 more rolls of labLocked*. If C joins within 180 s, C instead burns 1.5 s per box and gets '被人抢先搜走了'.
confirmed.fix: Add a `refill := true` parameter to _door_apply. In net_ex_sync, apply doors with refill=false. In the 'still inside' branch of net_ex_door (and on any reopen received with an empty refill list), set dr.open/t and call level.set_door only, without touching boxes. On the host, stop expiring key-room entries: either send a `room` flag with ex_box_claim and treat CD as INF for those (cleared only by _ex_log_door refill), or have _ex_sync_req send every _ex_boxes entry and let the client's _box_opened rules decide what is still opened.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. extract_manager.gd:3576-3583: net_ex_sync calls _box_set for each box first, then _door_apply(id,true,t) for each open door. _door_apply (1897-1903) sets b.t=-INF and refreshes the visual for every box in that room, so the joiner sees every box in an open key room as full. Separately, net.gd:1148-1150 (_ex_sync_req) only sends entries younger than EX_BOX_CD, and _ex_box_judge (983) only rejects entries younger than 180 s. Key-room boxes never expire on the client (_box_opened 1778-1779), and the host only clears them via _ex_log_door refill (1014-1015). So a box opened more than 180 s ago is shown full to the joiner and the host approves the claim (991-992). The joiner rolls the locked table again (ExData.box_table(...,true) at 1838) without spending a key. The 'I'm still inside' branch (1912-1916) also calls _door_apply(open=true) and rebroadcasts with refill [], and other clients take the plain open branch (1921), so the reopen refills locally everywhere. That second path needs a boundary race in _update_doors (1941-1946 judge the remote puppet's position), so it is rare. I downgraded from critical: this is a key-room loot exploit for late joiners (no crash, no duplication of an existing item). Joiners are common during the 900 s window.

confirmed.title: A host returning to its kept room gets no box/door/boss/doctor state
confirmed.detail: Only non-hosts call `ex_sync_req` (line 847), and `net.ex_sync_req()` itself returns early for the host (net.gd line 1138). When the host extracts or dies while others are still inside, `keep_room` keeps the room alive. The host's `_ex_boxes/_ex_doors/_ex_bosses/_ex_doc` tables keep recording everything clients do, but when the host re-enters ('回到你开的房间'), its new manager starts from defaults: every box full, every key-room door closed (a solid box, so the host is physically blocked from rooms others can walk into), every boss in state 0, and no doctor info. When the host walks within 110 m of a boss that is in cooldown for everyone else, it spawns the boss, and the others adopt it as live (`_adopt_boss` sets state 1). Summon altars also show as ready. The boss respawns early and drops 16-48 extra items plus xianyu. The doctor can be rescued twice in one cycle: the host's local doctor spawns even though a client rescued it (host record state 3). The host's claim is approved because holder is 0, and `net_ex_doc_owner(1, 2, pos)` makes every other client spawn a fresh doctor without checking `_doc_cycle_done`. The 1M lingshi + 20 xianyu reward is paid again.
confirmed.trigger: Desert, 2+ players. The host kills nothing and extracts at 6:00, and a client kills 沙渊巨虫 at room time 500 (long respawn). The host re-enters the same room at 520, walks to the worm arena, and the boss spawns immediately. Everyone else sees it via puppet and can farm it again. In parallel, key room k11 is open on everyone's screen but closed (and solid) on the host's.
confirmed.fix: Add net.ex_sync_local(): call _ex_tab(), filter boxes as for joiners (see the net-1 fix), then call raid.net_ex_sync(boxes, _ex_doors, _ex_bosses, _ex_doc). Call it from extract_manager._ready when net.is_host and _ex_seed == seed_v (that is, after enter_world while re-entering a kept room). In net_ex_doc_owner, ignore state 1/2 when _doc_cycle_done == _doc_cycle(), and have _ex_doc_judge reject a claim when the record is state 3 for the current cycle (store the cycle in _ex_doc, see net-4).
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. extract_manager.gd:847 only sends ex_sync_req when not net.is_host, and net.gd:1138 also returns early for the host. The host's _ex_* tables survive keep_room because _ex_tab (953) resets only when the seed changes, so they stay accurate. They are never applied to the host's new manager when it re-enters (main.gd:892-900 'own_room' path, net.enter_world 431-448 only restores dug/drops). The host's manager starts with bosses at state 0 (2900), doors from the map defaults (1867), boxes at -INF and _doc_cycle_done=-1 (194). A non-summon boss in cooldown elsewhere respawns when the host comes within BOSS_SPAWN_R (3063). Others adopt the host's boss through net_mob_apply→_adopt_boss (2750, 2927 sets state 1). It drops loot again (3104-3109) and grants xianyu to the killer. Doctor: if a client already rescued (host record {0,3}), the host spawns a fresh local doctor (3418-3425). _ex_doc_judge passes because h=0 (1087-1090), and clients' net_ex_doc_owner(1,2,pos) spawns a doctor without checking _doc_cycle_done (3500-3503). The host can then extract with it and get DOCTOR_LINGSHI/XIANYU_DOCTOR again (1531-1545). Correction to the trigger: 沙渊巨虫 is a summon boss, which never auto-spawns on approach (3063 requires not summon). For it, the host instead sees the altar as ready (state 0) and can summon it early via _summon (3073-3086). The approach spawn applies to non-summon bosses such as 凌幽.

confirmed.title: Simultaneous boss spawns: the winning owner overwrites its own boss with the loser's puppet, leaving a duplicate invisible boss
confirmed.detail: When two players cross `BOSS_SPAWN_R` before either has seen the other's batch, both spawn the boss. `_saw_boss` makes the higher-id side free its fresh copy, but the lower-id side (the one that keeps its boss) returns early from `_saw_boss` (line 2936). It then still builds a puppet for the other side's boss in `net_mob_apply` and calls `_adopt_boss(b, sub, puppet)` (lines 2745-2750). That sets `b.node = puppet` and drops the reference to its own live boss. Its real boss stays alive under `_mob_root` and keeps attacking it, but it is no longer in `_my_mobs()`, so it is never broadcast. Other players can't see or hit it. Once the yielded puppet goes stale (1.5 s), `b` falls back to state 0 and the next tick spawns another boss (another '现身' banner). The result is two real bosses, two loot showers and two xianyu awards. When the orphan dies, `_on_boss_died` nulls whatever `b.node` points to at that moment and broadcasts `ex_boss_dead` while another copy is alive.
confirmed.trigger: Two teammates walk side by side into the pyramid zone (or both arrive through the cave teleport). Both `_update_bosses` ticks fire within ~0.1 s of each other, before either has received the other's 10 Hz mob batch. Host (id 1) plus client both spawn 凌幽. The client yields, but the host's `_bosses` entry now points at the client's soon-to-be-freed puppet.
confirmed.fix: In net_mob_apply, for an entry with lair >= 0: if b[node/node2] is a valid non-puppet boss of mine, do not create or adopt the puppet. Skip the entry when owner_id > my_id (they yield). When owner_id < my_id and my boss could not yield (damaged or older), free mine and adopt theirs, so the outcome is always exactly one. Also make _adopt_boss refuse to overwrite a valid non-puppet node. The more robust fix is to arbitrate boss spawns and summons on the host (ex_boss_claim like ex_box_claim, with state recorded in _ex_bosses).
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. _saw_boss (2934-2942) returns immediately when owner_id > _my_id(), so the lower-id side keeps its own boss. net_mob_apply then still creates a puppet for the other side's boss and calls _adopt_boss(b, lair%2, m) (2745-2750), which overwrites b.node with the puppet (2926). _my_mobs (2668-2675) derives owned bosses only from b.node/node2, so the real boss is no longer broadcast but keeps fighting under _mob_root. The higher-id side frees its boss silently (2941, no death message), so the lower side's puppet goes stale after 1.5 s (raid_mob.gd:699-701). b then reverts to state 0 (3065-3067, back=0.0) and _update_bosses spawns again (3063-3064). The yielding side also adopted a puppet of a boss that its owner has stopped broadcasting, so its puppet also goes stale after 1.5 s and it can respawn too. The race repeats, giving multiple real bosses, banners and loot showers (_on_boss_died 3091-3125 for each orphan). _update_bosses runs every 0.4 s (1043-1048) and batches go out at 10 Hz. When two players cross the radius together, both spawn whenever the second tick lands before the first batch arrives, which is a realistic window. If the higher side's boss is already damaged or older than 3 s, neither yields and both orphan their own bosses.

confirmed.title: A doctor held at nightfall stays 'held' in the host's record, so the doctor can never be claimed in later days
confirmed.detail: At night each client's `_update_doctor_spawn` vanishes the doctor locally and sets `_doc_holder = 0` (extract_manager lines 3407-3417). No message is sent, so the host's `_ex_doc` stays `{holder: H, state: 2}`. On the next day every client spawns a fresh local doctor. When someone clicks 营救, `_ex_doc_judge` returns silently whenever `players.has(H)` and state == 2 (lines 1087-1089). If H is the host, it stays in `players` even while away in the hub, so the doctor is unclaimable for the rest of the room's life, even for the host itself. Late joiners get this stale record in `_ex_sync`, so `net_ex_doc_owner(H, 2, oldpos)` spawns the doctor at an old position and makes it follow H's puppet while everyone else sees it standing unowned. That is the 'doctor following someone' desync. A related case: a stale state 3 from a previous cycle makes a joiner set `_doc_cycle_done` to the current cycle (lines 3493-3498), so the joiner never sees that day's doctor until someone else claims it.
confirmed.trigger: Lab. The host rescues the doctor at day second 250, fights mobs and doesn't reach an extract before day second 600. Night falls and the doctor vanishes. The host dies, then re-enters, or other players stay in the room. 1200 s later the doctor reappears for everyone, but every 营救 click does nothing (silently rejected every 2 s), and anyone who joins sees it trailing the host.
confirmed.fix: Store the cycle in _ex_doc ({holder, state, pos, cyc}), sent by the claimer or computed on the host from room_t. In _ex_doc_judge and _ex_sync_req, treat a record from an older cycle as empty. In net_ex_doc_owner, ignore state 3 whose cyc != _doc_cycle(). When the doctor vanishes at night and I am the holder, send ex_doc_state(0, 1, pos) (or a dedicated 'gone for cycle' state) so the host clears the holder.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. At night, _update_doctor_spawn (3407-3417) vanishes the doctor and sets _doc_holder=0 and _doc_cycle_done locally, but sends nothing. _die→_doc_release later sees doctor==null and returns without _doc_net_state (3473-3475). The host record stays {holder:H, state:2} (net.gd 1090/1105). In the next cycle, _ex_doc_judge (1087-1089) silently rejects every claim while players.has(H). A host H stays in players while away (keep_room only marks 'away', 382-384), so the doctor is permanently unclaimable in that room, even by the host itself. Joiners get the stale record via _ex_sync (1151) → net_ex_doc_owner(H,2,oldpos) (3587). That spawns the doctor at the old position with _doc_holder=H, so the joiner gets no rescue card (2004). A stale state 3 from an earlier cycle sets the joiner's _doc_cycle_done to the current cycle (3493-3498), so the joiner never sees that day's free doctor. Downgraded: every case needs a room older than about 1380 s (DAY_LEN+NIGHT_LEN = 1200 plus DOCTOR_WIN, with RAID_T 900 per entry), which happens only in kept or continuously occupied rooms. The result is a lost feature and desync, not duplication.

confirmed.title: Canghong's 断月 / 天斩 sword-wave visuals are never shown to other players in the new maps
confirmed.detail: `kit_canghong._spawn_wave` finds the network through `player.get_meta("net")` (kit_canghong.gd 203-205). net.gd `_ready` sets that meta (line 97). The main net is created first in main `_ready` (main.gd 224-227). Then the hub is added (main.gd 234-241), which builds `ArenaDuel` (hub_hall 188-196). ArenaDuel creates `ArenaNet` with `_net.player = player` (arena_duel 132-136), and `arena_net._ready` calls `super()`, which overwrites the meta with the arena net. Outside a duel that net is inactive, so `send_hero_fx` returns at its `not active` check and `_hero_fx` is never sent in desert/lab raids. The wave's damage still reaches remote puppets through `air_hit` and `net_deal_hit`, so victims are hit by an invisible projectile. H only tested this in the arena, where the arena net is the right one.
confirmed.trigger: LAN desert raid. Player A (苍鸿) uses Q 断月 or the awakened giant 天斩 on player B. B takes the hit and knockback but sees no crescent wave at all.
confirmed.fix: Keep the meta pointing at the main net. In arena_net._ready, save player.get_meta("net") before super() and restore it afterwards. Set the meta to the arena net only while an arena room is open (open_room/join_room) and restore it in leave(). Alternatively, have kit_canghong call send_hero_fx on both main.net and the arena net; each already gates on active and raid.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. kit_canghong.gd:203-205 looks up the net with player.get_meta("net"). net.gd:96-97 sets that meta in _ready whenever player != null. main.gd:222-225 creates the main Net first. The hub is added at 233-241 in normal (non-legacy) play, and hub_hall.gd:188 builds ArenaDuel. On non-web builds, arena_duel.gd:133-136 sets `_net.player = player` before add_child(_net). arena_net.gd:52 calls super(), which re-runs net.gd _ready and overwrites the meta with the ArenaNet. Nothing ever sets it back (net.gd:97 is the only set_meta("net")). In desert/lab raids, send_hero_fx on the ArenaNet returns at `not active` (net.gd:858), so _hero_fx is never sent. Remote victims are still hit through the normal _hit path but never see the crescent or 天斩 wave. H's report only mentions testing this in the arena.

confirmed.title: Matchmaking stops listening at the first room heard even if it is another map, so players split into separate rooms
confirmed.detail: `_matchmake` waits `while t < wait and net.rooms.is_empty()` and leaves the loop as soon as any room has been heard. The map filter added in this refactor (line 993) then discards it. Same-map rooms broadcast only once per second, so if an other-map room (legacy 木兰, or a kept room on the other new map) is heard first, the same-map room is never considered. `best_ip` stays empty and the player hosts a new room. Before the filter existed, the early exit was harmless.
confirmed.trigger: LAN has a 木兰 room (or a lab room kept by a host idling in the hub) and an existing desert room. Player C matchmakes for desert. The lab broadcast arrives at 0.2 s, the desert one at 0.7 s. The loop exits at 0.2 s, the lab room is filtered out, and C hosts a second desert room. With N other-map rooms the miss chance is about N/(N+1) per attempt, and later players then pick whichever desert room is bigger.
confirmed.fix: Make the loop condition map-aware: keep waiting while t < wait and no room in net.rooms matches the target map (use the same predicate as line 993). Only after the wait expires, pick the best matching room or host.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed with a corrected trigger. main.gd:985 exits the wait loop on any heard room, and the map filter added in this refactor (993) then discards other-map rooms (the backup main.gd.txt:898-907 has no filter). The stated timing (rooms first heard 0.2 s or 0.7 s into _matchmake) is mostly wrong: discovery already starts when the entry page opens (level_select.gd:240) and is not stopped for match (208-209). net runs PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS and leave() does not clear rooms, so after about 1 s on the page every broadcasting room is already in net.rooms. The real failure is the stagger the wait exists for (comment at 983): two players clicking 开始匹配 together on desert while any lab or mulan room is on the LAN. rooms is non-empty, so both exit at t≈0, filter everything out, and both host separate desert rooms. Without the other-map room, the later player would keep waiting and hear the first player's new room. The same applies to a player who clicks less than 1 s after a same-map room was created.

confirmed.title: If the doctor's holder disconnects, the doctor is stuck as 'held' on every remaining client until night
confirmed.detail: Nothing in extract_manager reacts to a peer leaving. If the holder crashes, quits or loses connection (`room_lost` → `_die` → `_doc_release` → `_doc_net_state` does nothing because net is already inactive), every other client keeps `_doc_holder = <gone id>` and `remote = true`. The doctor freezes at its last pushed position. The 营救 card requires `_doc_holder == 0` (line 2004) and `_doc_rescue` returns early when `_doc_holder != 0` (line 3443), so nobody can send a claim, even though the host's judge would allow one (`players.has(h)` is false). Late joiners get `{holder: gone, state 2}` and also end up with `_doc_holder = gone`.
confirmed.trigger: Lab. Player B carries the doctor at day second 260 and alt-F4s (or B's Wi-Fi drops). For the remaining ~340 s of daylight, the doctor stands frozen with no rescue card for anyone.
confirmed.fix: In _tick_doctor (or on net.roster_changed), if _doc_holder != 0 and _doc_holder != _my_id() and not net.players.has(_doc_holder), release locally (holder 0, follow(null), remote=false). On the host, in _on_peer_disconnected, if _ex_doc.holder == id, set {0, 1, pos} and broadcast _ex_doc_owner(0, 1, pos).
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. A disconnect reaches clients only as _roster/_drop_remote (net.gd:295-299, 419-426), and extract_manager has no roster_changed handler (grep finds none in scripts/ex). Remaining clients keep _doc_holder = gone id with doctor.remote=true and no more ex_doc_pos pushes (3514-3517), so the doctor is frozen. The rescue card requires _doc_holder == 0 (2004) and _doc_rescue returns early when _doc_holder != 0 (3443), so nobody can send a claim, although the host judge would allow one (1088: players.has(h) is false). The holder's own _die→_doc_release cannot help on a crash or connection loss. Late joiners receiving {gone,2} also set _doc_holder to the gone id via _doc_take (3511). This lasts until nightfall (3407-3416).

confirmed.title: A late joiner's drop list is a snapshot taken at handshake, so drops made or picked up during loading go missing or become permanent phantoms
confirmed.detail: `_hello` captures `raid.net_drop_list()` and sends `_welcome` at connect time (lines 323-326), before the joiner's level and manager exist. Until the manager's `_ready` calls `enter_world` (one to several seconds of loading), incoming `_drop` and `_granted` are thrown away because `raid == null` and `_log_on` is false (lines 778-783, 809-814). `ex_sync_req` resyncs boxes/doors/bosses/doctor but not drops. Items sprayed from boxes or bosses in that window never appear for the joiner. Items picked up in that window stay on the joiner's screen. When the joiner clicks one, `_claim_on_host` silently ignores the already-claimed nid (lines 803-804), and the client's `claiming` meta is never cleared (extract_manager 2255-2257), so the item stays visible forever with no card.
confirmed.trigger: A busy room. Player B opens a weapon box and picks up its drop while player C is on the load screen after connecting. C never sees B's other sprayed drops, and sees the picked-up sword on the ground permanently. Clicking it does nothing.
confirmed.fix: Have the host answer a claim for an already-claimed nid with _granted(nid, owner) to that claimer only, so stale ghosts are removed. Add a claim timeout using the existing claim_t meta (for example, clear 'claiming' after 3 s). Optionally include the host's current drop list in _ex_sync and reconcile pending drops against _claimed.
confirmed.evidence: Mechanism confirmed, but the window is much smaller than stated, and the pattern predates this refactor. _hello (net.gd:323-326) snapshots raid.net_drop_list() at handshake. _drop and _granted are dropped while raid == null and _log_on is false on a client (778-783, 809-814), and _ex_sync carries no drops (1151). However, ExLevel creates the manager inside its own _ready (ex_level.gd:189-201) at add_child(level) (main.gd:947), before prewarm and Warm.run, and manager._ready calls net.enter_world immediately (extract_manager.gd:841). So the window is the 0.7 s team-size timer in _matchmake (main.gd:1007-1009) plus a frame, not 'one to several seconds'. A pickup in that window leaves a ghost item. After one click, _claim sets 'claiming' forever (2255-2257, claim_t never read) and the host ignores already-claimed nids (net.gd:803-804), so the card hides but the mesh stays. The same snapshot, ignore and claiming code exists in the legacy net.gd/raid_manager (backup net.gd.txt:307, raid_manager.gd:2204).

confirmed.title: PvP hits drain 玄龟镜 shell and 法宝 durability, and cancel channels, even when the hit is parried, blocked or ignored
confirmed.detail: `net_take_hit` (from > 0) runs `_absorb_shell(d)`, `ExData.wear_chips(equip, d)` and sets `_hurt_mark = true` (lines 1242-1251) before handing the hit to `player.air.receive_attack` / `player.melee.receive_attack` (lines 1258-1262). Those can reject it entirely: Canghong parry (returns 2), swat (1), vanish, `_prot` protection after getting up, dash or iframe (-1). In all those cases the defender still loses shell and chip durability for damage never taken, and `_hurt_mark` cancels the extract or box read even though no damage got through.
confirmed.trigger: Defender in 回风/剑域 guard (or in the post-knockdown protection window) inside an extract zone. An attacker lands 3 hits that are all parried or ignored. The defender's 玄龟镜 shell drops by the full clamped amount, chip durability ticks down (possibly '法宝耐久耗尽'), and the 5 s extract read restarts each time.
confirmed.fix: Resolve the hit first, then charge the defensive resources. Pass the armor-reduced d to receive_attack and capture its result. Only when the result is 0 (landed), apply _absorb_shell, wear_chips and _hurt_mark. To keep the shell absorbing damage, take the HP delta after receive_attack, refund min(shell, delta) to HP and subtract it from _shell. Apply the same change to the mob atk_out path, so shell and _hurt_mark depend on the actual outcome.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. In net_take_hit (from > 0), _absorb_shell(d), ExData.wear_chips(equip, d) and _hurt_mark=true all run (1242-1251) before player.air/melee.receive_attack (1258-1262). air_melee.receive_attack (3541-3602) rejects or reduces many hits after that point: dash, iframe, ult or dun (-1 at 3542), CLASH/BRAWL/GRABBED (-1), _prot post-knockdown protection (-1 at 3550), DOWN vs PvP (-1), parry (_try_parry 3557-3561), vanish (2), swat (1), and guard (1, only 15% HP loss). In all of these the defender still loses shell and chip durability for the full clamped amount, and _hurt_mark interrupts channels and extract reads (1007, 1016-1019). The PvE path does the same: to_player_from (1090-1096) absorbs shell and sets _hurt_mark before the mob's receive_attack decides.

confirmed.title: Kill counts are inflated for teammates and doubled for boss kills by a remote player
confirmed.detail: `net_mob_died` gives `kills += 1` whenever `share` is true and the mob is within 100 m. In net.gd, `share` is `last_hitter == my_id or is_mate(from)` (originally an XP-sharing flag), so every teammate near any kill of a teammate-owned mob gets a kill. For bosses, the remote killer gets +1 here and another +1 in `net_ex_boss_dead` (lines 3138-3141). The inflated `kills` goes into the result screen and `ExProfile` stats (`st.kills`).
confirmed.trigger: A 4-player team clears a camp owned by one teammate. Each of the other three is credited with every kill. A remote player who lands the last hit on 凌幽 shows 2 kills for it.
confirmed.fix: Pass last_hitter (or a separate is_killer flag) to net_mob_died and count kills only when last_hitter == my_id. Drop the extra kills += 1 in net_ex_boss_dead, or skip the 2836 increment when lair >= 0.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. net.gd:927 passes share = last_hitter == my_id or is_mate(from), and extract_manager.gd:2835-2836 adds kills += 1 whenever share is true and the death is within 100 m. Every teammate near a mob owned by a mate gets a kill. For a boss owned by someone else and last-hit by me, _on_boss_died sends send_mob_dead with last_hitter = me (3094), which gives +1 via 2836, and then ex_boss_dead (3121) gives another +1 in net_ex_boss_dead (3141). kills feeds result and ExProfile stats.kills (ex_profile.gd:671). The impact is display and stats only.

confirmed.title: The host's hero in the roster isn't refreshed when it re-enters its kept room, so others see the wrong model/weapon
confirmed.detail: `players[1]["hero"]` is set only in `host()` (line 177). `enter_world` re-teams the returning host (lines 442-448) but doesn't update `hero` (or `realm`). If the host switches hero in the hub lobby (`ex_lobby_ui` calls `player.set_hero` right away) while the room is kept, the roster broadcast still carries the old id. Every client's puppet `_apply_hero` then builds the old skin and sword (for example no sword for 苍鸿 → 御剑).
confirmed.trigger: The host extracts while a client is still inside (room kept), switches from 御剑 to 苍鸿 in 备战, and re-enters. The client sees the host as the old 阿拉灯 model with no sword, while Canghong poses and waves come from it.
confirmed.fix: In enter_world's re-entry branch, set me["hero"] = _my_hero() and me["realm"] = player.realm_idx before _roster.rpc(players).
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. players[1].hero is written only in host() (net.gd:177). enter_world's re-entry branch (442-448) updates size, team and away but not hero or realm. ex_lobby_ui.gd:740-761 changes ExProfile hero and calls player.set_hero immediately in the hub. Clients' puppets read the hero only from the roster (remote_player.gd:70, 124-125 via set_info), so after the host switches hero in a kept room, others build the old skin and blade.

confirmed.title: Late joiners don't receive camp death times, so cleared camps can respawn early
confirmed.detail: `Camps._dead` is local. In-world peers learn deaths through `net_mob_died` (lair ≤ -2), but `_ex_sync` carries no camp state and the host keeps no camp table. A joiner near a camp that was cleared less than 75 s ago has `alive()` true for every slot. If no lower-id peer is within `MAT_R` (or the killers have moved on), the joiner rebuilds the full camp, and everyone sees and can farm it again.
confirmed.trigger: Player A clears a desert camp near spawn point 2 and walks 120 m away. Player C joins 20 s later at spawn point 2, and the camp rebuilds with full HP and loot rolls 55 s early.
confirmed.fix: On the host, record camp death times from _mob_dead/send_mob_dead with lair <= -2 (keyed by seed and code) and include them in _ex_sync. Apply them in net_ex_sync via camps.on_dead(cd/8, cd%8, t, ...) so the 75 s respawn uses the room clock.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. Camp deaths reach peers already in the world through net_mob_died (lair <= -2 → camps.on_dead, 2832-2834). The host keeps no camp table, and _ex_sync (net.gd:1151) carries only boxes, doors, bosses and doctor. A joiner's Camps._dead is empty, so alive(c, slot) is true for every slot. The joiner builds the camp when no lower-id live peer is within MAT_R and the camp is not _owned_by_other (574, 588-597). revived is false, so the BUSY_R guard (593-595) does not apply. The only delay is the first-6-s _hold near the spawn (568-573), which is released once the joiner moves 40 m away. A camp cleared less than 75 s ago therefore comes back early for that joiner and becomes farmable by everyone.

confirmed.title: A remote's awakening outline lasts a fixed 14 s even when Canghong's awakening ends early
confirmed.detail: `air_awaken` FX calls `remote.awaken_fx(14.0)` with a hard-coded duration. H added `end_awaken` (air_melee 4465, `awake_t = 0.001` after 万剑归宗), so the real awakening can end well before 14 s. The puppet's state-packet bit 32 clears (sword glow stops), but `_awake_fx` keeps showing the awakened outline and space ripple. Opponents then read a non-awakened player as awakened.
confirmed.trigger: Player A awakens and uses 万剑归宗 4 s later, which ends the awakening. Player B keeps seeing A outlined as awakened for about 10 more seconds.
confirmed.fix: In remote_player, track the bit-32 flag. On a falling edge, stop or fade _awake_fx (add a stop() to AwakenFx if needed). Optionally start it on the rising edge instead of relying only on the air_awaken FX event.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. net.gd:633 calls remote.awaken_fx(14.0) with a fixed duration (pre-existing). This refactor added air_melee.end_awaken (4463-4465, awake_t=0.001), which both heroes' finishers call: kit_yujian.gd:98 (大罡剑阵) and kit_canghong.gd:241 (万剑归宗). remote_player only uses state flag bit 32 for the blade emission (233) and never stops _awake_fx (awaken_fx.gd start(secs) only), so the outline and ripple keep running for the rest of the 14 s after the real awakening has ended.

confirmed.title: LAN: anyone who joins mid-raid can loot key-room boxes again without a key
confirmed.detail: Three pieces combine. (1) net_ex_sync applies box open-times first, then calls _door_apply(id, true, t) for every open door. _door_apply(open) sets t=-INF on every box in that room (lines 1899-1903), so on the joiner's screen all key-room boxes look full again. (2) net.gd _ex_sync_req (line 1149) only sends boxes opened less than 180 s ago, so older room boxes would look full even without the refill. (3) The host's referee net.gd _ex_box_judge (line 983) gives every box the same 180 s cooldown. But in the manager, key-room boxes are supposed to refill only when the door is opened (_box_opened line 1778). So any key-room box looted more than 180 s ago is approved again, with no key spent. The locked supply table is 4 draws of purple/orange/red/color sellables (about 2 million per box in D's stats).
confirmed.trigger: LAN. Player A uses a key on a lab key room at room time T and loots its 2-4 boxes. Player B matchmakes into the room (or A extracts and re-matches into the same room) at T+200 s, while the door is still open (open for 900 s). B gets _ex_sync, sees every box full, opens each one, and the host approves because more than 180 s have passed. Repeat every ~3 minutes until the door closes at 900 s: one key pays out the room 3-4 times.
confirmed.fix: (1) In net.gd _ex_sync_req, send every _ex_boxes entry with no age filter. Wild boxes still expire through _box_opened's BOX_CD check, and room boxes are already erased from _ex_boxes when the door reopens (_ex_log_door 1014-1015). (2) In net_ex_sync, apply the doors first and the box times after them, or give _door_apply a refill=false flag for sync. (3) Make the host authoritative: in _ex_log_door, record every idx that appears in a refill array (the first open lists every box in that room) as a room box. In _ex_box_judge, refuse a room box that is still present in _ex_boxes, whatever its age.
confirmed.evidence: extract_manager.gd:3576-3583 net_ex_sync applies box times first, then calls _door_apply(id,true,t) for each open door. _door_apply (1897-1903) sets t=-INF on every box whose room==id, so the joiner sees every key-room box as full. net.gd:1148-1150 _ex_sync_req only sends boxes opened < EX_BOX_CD (180 s) ago, so older boxes would look full even without that reset. net.gd:983 _ex_box_judge refuses only when room_t - opened < 180 for every box. The manager's own rule (1778-1779, and E_core.md:463, which states it is meant to stop farming during the 900 s door window) is that key-room boxes only refill when the door opens. A joiner arrives through the normal matchmake flow (main.gd:901-902 joins the existing room) and calls ex_sync_req (847). The joiner's box_open(idx) is true, so the claim goes to the host, and any room box looted more than 180 s ago is approved and rolled from the locked table (1838, about 2M per box per D_econ.md:200). The door stays open 900 s (KEY_ROOM_T, line 61) and longer while someone is inside, so one key pays out the room several times, once per joiner or re-join.

confirmed.title: Host who re-enters a room kept open for others gets a blank room state: bosses and summon altars come back early
confirmed.detail: Only clients request ex_sync (line 847: `if not bool(net.is_host)`). When the host extracts while others are still inside, net.keep_room keeps the room, and net._ex_bosses/_ex_doors/_ex_boxes keep recording (net.gd 1030-1041). But when the host comes back ('再入境回到这间房', an advertised flow), its new manager starts with every boss in state 0, every altar ready, every door closed and every box unopened. Nothing applies the host's own _ex_* tables. _update_bosses (line 3063) then respawns any boss the host walks near, even inside the 500/600 s respawn or summon cooldown. Clients adopt the host's puppet, and _on_boss_died rolls the full table again (16 draws, or 48 for the 铁穹双卫 twins) plus +5 仙玉.
confirmed.trigger: LAN host and client in lab. Someone kills 凌影 at T (600 s respawn). Host extracts at T+60; the client stays, so the room is kept. Host picks 匹配 at gate 3 and returns to the same room, walks to the 尸傀密窟 lair at T+120, and the boss spawns again. Killing it drops another yanjiuBossDrops1 ×16 + 5 仙玉. The same works for the summon bosses (沙渊巨虫 / 铁穹双卫): their altars show as ready.
confirmed.fix: In _ready, after _setup_boxes/_setup_doors/_setup_bosses: if net_on() and net.is_host and net._ex_seed == net.seed_v, feed the host's own tables in with net_ex_sync(net._ex_boxes, net._ex_doors, net._ex_bosses, net._ex_doc). Pass the boxes unfiltered and apply the econ-1 ordering fix first, so the door refill does not wipe the box state. A small net.ex_state() accessor is the cleanest way to expose the tables.
confirmed.evidence: extract_manager.gd:847 only non-hosts call ex_sync_req, and no other manager code reads net._ex_bosses/_ex_doors/_ex_boxes (grep finds nothing). net.gd:369-385 keep_room keeps the room, and _ex_tab (952-958) clears the tables only when seed_v changes, so the host's records survive. main.gd:892-900 sends the host back into its own room on 匹配/建房. The new manager starts every boss at state 0 (2900). _update_bosses (3063-3064) spawns a non-summon boss as soon as the host comes within BOSS_SPAWN_R, and _summon (3077) only checks the local state 2. Clients adopt the host's puppet (_adopt_boss 2927 forces state=1 over their cooldown). _on_boss_died (3104-3121) rolls the full table, shares the drops and gives XIANYU_BOSS. The host also sees every key-room door closed (_setup_doors 1867, set_door never called) while clients see it open.

confirmed.title: Item duplication: drop items for a LAN teammate, then close the game within the 2 s sync gap
confirmed.detail: sync_live only writes when `_sync_t <= 0 or (_sync_dirty and _sync_wait <= 0)` (line 1037), and every sync resets _sync_wait to SYNC_MIN = 2 s. ui_drop removes the stack from the bag, sends it to the room (_reg_drop → net.send_drop), and only sets _sync_dirty. If a sync happened in the last 2 s, the live lock still lists the dropped stacks. Closing the window (Alt+F4 or kill) skips any final sync; the manager has no _notification hook. On the next start, _recover_live rebuilds the profile bag from that stale snapshot, minus only 2 random sellable stacks, chips and 5000. Meanwhile the teammate already holds the dropped items.
confirmed.trigger: LAN client A has 8 stacks of red/color sellables. A picks up any item (this syncs and arms the 2 s window), immediately drops the valuable stacks (ui_drop), and closes the game. Teammate B picks them up and extracts. A restarts: _recover_live returns the dropped stacks to A's bag, minus at most 2. If A is the host, closing also triggers room_collapsed, so B 'extracts' instantly (see econ-6).
confirmed.fix: In ui_drop, call ExProfile.sync_live(bag, equip) immediately (ignore SYNC_MIN) and reset _sync_wait. Do the same for the other removal paths (_door_read key, _med_apply, _throw, revive take_id); those are consume-only, so they matter less. Also do a final sync_live from a NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST handler in the manager. That covers Alt+F4, but not a hard kill, which is why the immediate sync on removal is the main fix.
confirmed.evidence: ui_drop (extract_manager.gd:2203-2212) removes the stack and only sets _sync_dirty. _drop_item → _reg_drop (2245) sends it to the room at once. sync_live runs only when _sync_t<=0 or (_sync_dirty and _sync_wait<=0) (1037-1041), and every sync resets _sync_wait to SYNC_MIN=2 s. Any pickup (_take 2292), wear (2157) or unequip (2188) sets the dirty flag and syncs on the next frame, so the player chooses when the 2 s window starts. Closing the window goes net._notification → _quit_after_close → close_room → leave() → quit (net.gd:103-113, 237-241); for a client there is no wait and no manager sync, and _exit_tree (965-975) does not sync either. On the next start, _recover_live (ex_profile.gd:163-189) rebuilds the bag from live.bag, minus only death_drops (ex_data.gd:1377-1409: 2 random sellable stacks, or fewer kept by a ward, plus the chips). The teammate already holds the dropped items. Doing it on purpose (unequip or wear, drop, Alt+F4 within 2 s) is easy with the bag UI open.

confirmed.title: A truncated or corrupt save is silently replaced by a fresh account on the next action
confirmed.detail: save() opens the real file with FileAccess.WRITE, which truncates first, and writes it directly: no temp file, no backup. _load() treats any parse failure as `_d = _fresh()` (not even _new_save, so no starter gear) and does not save. The next operation of any kind (begin_raid, sync_live, add_xianyu, any lobby click) then overwrites the unreadable file. Stash, lingshi, 仙玉, rank and vouchers are all lost with no notice. The new save is written very often: sync_live every 15 s and after each pickup during a raid, and killing the game mid-raid is an explicitly supported flow.
confirmed.trigger: Mid-raid, the process is killed (Task Manager, power loss, mobile browser killing the tab) while a sync_live save() is writing. The file is left half-written. Next start: JSON.parse_string returns null, the player sees a gearless account with 1,000,000 lingshi, and the first click saves over the old file for good.
confirmed.fix: Build the string first, write it to PATH+'.tmp', close the file, rename the current PATH to PATH+'.bak', then DirAccess.rename_absolute the tmp file over PATH. In _load, if the parse or the open fails, try '.bak'. If both fail, rename the bad file to '.corrupt' and set a notice before starting a fresh save. Never write over a file that failed to parse.
confirmed.evidence: ex_profile.gd:102-107 opens the real path with FileAccess.WRITE, which truncates, and JSON.stringify runs only after the open. Godot's backup-then-rename save is an editor-only setting and is off at runtime. There is no temp file and no backup. _load (85-95): a parse failure or a null open leaves _d = _fresh(), with no notice, no backup and no save. The next operation (begin_raid 632, sync_live 643, any lobby action) overwrites the unreadable file with a blank account. sync_live writes every 15 s and after each pickup. The trigger is rare (a kill or power loss in the few ms between truncate and close), and the legacy raid_profile.gd:248 uses the same pattern. Downgraded from high because of how rare it is, but the result when it happens is total account loss with no warning.

confirmed.title: The mid-raid lock is set before the map has loaded, so a crash during loading costs all chips and 5000
confirmed.detail: begin_raid (ex_profile.gd 626-632) writes the live lock and saves inside the manager's _ready. That runs during add_child(level) at main.gd:947, before `await level.prewarm()` (on web, up to 45 s of sliced chunk building) and Warm.run shader warm-up. The player gets control only later, in _start(). If the game dies anywhere in that loading window, _recover_live applies the full death penalty: every equipped 法宝 destroyed (some cost 50,000 to 10,000,000 in the shop), 5000 lingshi, and a death on the record, even though the player never got control.
confirmed.trigger: Mobile web: choose 沙海古墟, press 开始. The browser kills the tab for memory during the black loading screen (the known mobile-web reload problem). On reload, the three equipped chips are gone, 5000 lingshi are deducted, and stats.dead goes up by 1.
confirmed.fix: Have begin_raid write live with armed=false. Add ExProfile.arm_live(), called from the manager's _start(), which sets armed=true and saves. In _recover_live, treat an unarmed lock as an aborted load: clear it, keep everything, undo the raids+1 if wanted, and set a short notice.
confirmed.evidence: ExProfile.begin_raid writes the live lock and saves (ex_profile.gd:630-632) from the manager's _ready (extract_manager.gd:819-820). The manager is created inside ex_level._ready (ex_level.gd:189-201), which runs during add_child(level) at main.gd:947. That is before await level.prewarm() (main.gd:952; up to 45 s of sliced building on web, ex_level.gd:229-242) and Warm.run (954-956). The player only gets control in _start (888, gated in _process 995-998). A tab killed for memory during loading, the known mobile-web reload problem and the peak-memory phase, therefore triggers _recover_live's full death penalty: chips gone, 5000 lingshi, dead+1.

confirmed.title: Host closing the room gives every client a full extraction from anywhere, even while downed; the host can do it from the hub at no cost
confirmed.detail: room_collapsed calls _extract_done('room_collapsed'), which runs end_raid(ok=true) with the whole bag and adds its value to extract_total and rank. It checks only `running`, not whether the player is in an extraction zone or downed. The host can trigger it at zero cost: after extracting normally (the room is kept), the host picks 单人 at any gate (main.gd:895 calls net.close_room) or closes the window from the hub (net.gd _quit_after_close calls close_room). Every client still inside then extracts immediately. This follows SPEC 4.6 literally ('房主关房照撤离成功算'), but it lets players skip the extraction step entirely and rescue a downed friend from a PvP death.
confirmed.trigger: LAN pair. Host extracts and waits in the hub. Client loots, or gets downed by an enemy with 20 s of bleed left. Host clicks gate 2 → 单人 → 开始. The client's room_collapsed fires, they 'extract' with the full bag from the middle of the map or while downed, and the rank total goes up.
confirmed.fix: Lead/user decision. The minimum change: in room_collapsed, if player.is_downed(), do not count it as an extraction (use room_lost/_die, or restore the begin_raid snapshot with no loot and no rank). Options for the general case: count it as success only inside an extraction zone, or turn a host-initiated close into a no-penalty abort that returns the entry loadout without the new loot or rank gain.
confirmed.evidence: room_collapsed (extract_manager.gd:1611-1615) → _extract_done (1524-1545) runs end_raid(ok=true) with the full bag and extract_value. Nothing checks player.is_downed() or the extraction zone. main.gd:818-822 calls it on any host close. The host can trigger it at no cost after extracting: the room is kept (net.gd:369), and Alt+F4 in the hub (net.gd:103-113 → close_room 237-241 → _closing rpc) or 单人 at a gate (main.gd:895-896) fires it. The base rule is mandated by SPEC.md:246 ('房主关房照撤离成功算'), so this is not a SPEC violation. The concrete gap is that a downed client (seconds from a PvP death) and a host waiting in the hub turn it into a free 'panic button', which defeats extraction risk in LAN groups. Downgraded to medium because the base rule is a SPEC decision.

confirmed.title: On touch, a double tap gets past the 史诗 (q≥5) sell confirmation
confirmed.detail: The q≥5 confirmation is 'tap the same button again'. The first tap arms _confirm and calls _refresh(), which rebuilds the action row with a '确认卖出…' button that starts at the same x position (screenshot lobby_web_trader_confirm.jpg shows it in the exact spot). The same happens for the trader's 一键卖 buttons (lines 560-569). A fast double tap therefore sells. This matters most for non-sellables, which sell at token prices: an epic weapon bought for 648,000 sells for 1,620, and a 强心丹 cannot be bought back.
confirmed.trigger: Phone. In 备战, tap the 史诗破军锤 just bought for 64.8万, then double-tap '卖出（1620）'. It is sold at once and about 646,000 of value is lost. Same with the trader's '一键卖出背包售卖物' when the bag holds 史诗 items.
confirmed.fix: Store the arm time (Time.get_ticks_msec()) with _confirm. Ignore a confirm press that comes within about 450 ms of arming, and briefly disable the new confirm button (for example, set disabled=true and re-enable it with a 0.45 s timer). Or show the confirm as a separate 确认/取消 dialog in a different position.
confirmed.evidence: _sell_acts (ex_lobby_ui.gd:905-914): the first press on a q>=5 item only sets _confirm and returns. _act's handler (931-945) then calls _refresh(), and _build_detail rebuilds the _acts HBox in the same order. The sell button comes back in the same slot with the label '确认卖出…' and the same left x, and only it needs the second tap. Buttons fire on release and have no time guard, so the second tap of a double tap lands on the new button and sells. The trader's 一键卖出 (560-574) works the same way, rebuilt through _refresh(). The page is touch/mobile-first, and the hint text even says '再点一次'.

confirmed.title: Data-check tool writes to the player's real save when run without the trailing '--' argument
confirmed.detail: The tool relies on the caller passing '-- --data-check' to switch ExProfile to the test save. Nothing in the script checks this. Run without it, or with only '-- --keep-profile' (which is in PLAY_ARGS, so test_mode() stays false), it buys items, runs end_raid for an extraction and a death, and finally calls begin_raid('desert') and wipes memory without ending. That leaves a live lock in user://xiuxian_ex_profile.json, the same user:// folder the game uses.
confirmed.trigger: A developer or agent runs `godot --headless --path . --script res://_tasks/extraction_refactor/tools/ex_data_check.gd` without arguments. The real save gets the test purchases and results, and the next real start applies a death penalty from the dangling lock.
confirmed.fix: At the top of _init: if not ExProfile.test_mode(): push_error("ex_data_check needs -- --data-check"); quit(1); return.
confirmed.evidence: ex_data_check.gd:11-118 has no guard. ExProfile.test_mode() → RaidProfile.test_mode() (raid_profile.gd:44-48) is false with no user args, or with only '-- --keep-profile' (that flag is in PLAY_ARGS, line 37). _path() (ex_profile.gd:42-43) then returns the real user://xiuxian_ex_profile.json, the same project user:// folder the game uses. The tool runs buys, end_raid for an extraction and a death, and finally begin_raid('desert') with _d={} (110-111), which leaves a live lock that costs the next real start a death penalty.

confirmed.title: The crash-recovery penalty is only reported if the player opens the lobby
confirmed.detail: _recover_live stores what was lost in the static `notice`, and only ex_lobby_ui._ready shows it (take_notice). Nothing in the hub, level select or player plate reports it. A player who goes straight back through gate 2/3 is never told that 5000 lingshi, 2 sellable stacks and all chips were taken for the earlier mid-raid exit.
confirmed.trigger: Close the game mid-raid, restart, walk straight to gate 2 and start a new raid. The chips are gone with no message.
