confirmed.fix: Show the notice once when back in the hub (for example from hud._ex_rank_banner, or hub.say right after the first ExProfile load), or on the level-select entry page next to the loadout summary, and clear it there.
confirmed.evidence: _recover_live sets the static ExProfile.notice (ex_profile.gd:188). The only consumer is ex_lobby_ui.gd:179 (take_notice), and nothing in the hub, level_select, player_plate or hud reads it (hud.gd:193-201 only takes rank_up). A player who goes straight back through a gate never learns about the penalty. The stale text also stays in memory and is later prefixed to an unrelated rank-up notice (end_raid 685).

confirmed.title: 苍鸿 holding E (or the 瞬 touch button) starts the 御剑 万剑连发 volley and can enter 飞剑对波
confirmed.detail: In hero mode E only goes to kit.press(0), which fires 一闪. But `_tick_shot_hold` still counts how long `air_shot` is held for every hero, and `shot_hold()` only returns 0 in HURT/BLOWN/CHARGE/SMASH/RUSH/DASH/CRUSH, so ATTACK (the 一闪 itself) is not excluded. air_caster.tick (lines 177-182) then calls `_start_channel()` once `_held >= HOLD_T (0.28 s)` and mp >= 12. Nothing checks blade_always or the hero. The result: 苍鸿 fires 12 flying swords per second (`_volley_fan`, 0.5 u per sword in PvE, 0.275 u against players), drains 30 mp/s, and ignores the 一闪 cooldown. In `_tick_channel` an opponent who is also volleying makes `player.air.start_clash(foe)` put 苍鸿 into CLASH, even though `can_accept_clash`/`clash_warn` were patched to say 苍鸿 has no 对波. This breaks SPEC 6.4 (pure melee, swords: 0, 灵力只给技能用) and hands 苍鸿 about 6 u/s of ranged PvE damage, more than his whole kit.
confirmed.trigger: Pick 苍鸿, take off and hold E for about 0.3 s (on touch, keep a finger on 瞬). 一闪 fires, then a stream of flying swords follows for as long as E is held. Do it facing a volleying 御剑 or AI and both sides lock into 飞剑对波.

Nothing stops the hold from counting, though. air_melee.gd:2768 calls _tick_shot_hold for every hero on every air tick (3189-3190). shot_hold() (3194-3197) only excludes HURT/BLOWN/CHARGE/SMASH/RUSH/DASH/CRUSH, so ATTACK (a running k_issen) and IDLE both pass. air_caster.gd:177-183 then calls _start_channel once _held >= HOLD_T (0.28 s) and mp >= 12. 一闪 costs only 12 of 100 mp. Nothing in air_caster checks hero_id or blade_always. _tick_channel (247-272) fires player.realm['volley'] swords per second. canghong's realm override (hero_defs.gd:209-210) sets only 'swords': 0, and set_hero copies Realm.LIST[2] with volley 12.0 (player.gd:471-479, realm.gd:40), so 苍鸿 shoots 12 swords/s. The clash path is open too: _tick_channel:265 calls player.air.start_clash(foe), and start_clash (air_melee.gd:3995-4005) and foe_volley_started (4009-4012) have no blade_always guard. Only clash_warn (3942) and can_accept_clash (3973) were patched. Touch buttons send InputEventAction (touch_controls.gd:3,189-193), so holding 瞬 counts the same way. hero_selftest holds E only for yujian (hero_selftest.gd:204-209), so this path is never tested. confirmed.title: Ranged skills 断月 / 天斩 / 万剑归宗 still run the melee magnet and pull 苍鸿 up to ~36 m into the target
confirmed.detail: kit_canghong press(2) and press(3, awake) call `kit_move("k_dy1"/"k_tz"/"k_wj", player.air.pick_target(), …)`. `_pick_target` reaches out to RUSH_R = 36 m. `_start_move` resets `_rooted = false`, so `_tick_attack` treats these proj moves like a punch: before the hit, `drive_vel = to/(hit_t-_t)` capped at 80 m/s; after the hit it keeps sticking at 22 m/s. Legacy M1 only reaches this code after `_begin_combo` has already limited the distance to MAGNET 4.5 m or used a rush, and kit_move bypasses that. Per cast, 断月 (hit 0.08 s, chain 0.16 s, then k_dy2) drags the caster roughly 6.4 + 1.8 + 6.4 + 7 ≈ 20 m toward the enemy. 天斩 (hit 0.12 s) drags about 10 m. 万剑归宗 (hit 0.55 s at 80 m/s) covers the full 36 m and launches its 13 swords point-blank. The 'one ranged skill' of SPEC 6.4 becomes a gap-closer that pulls 苍鸿 into a 御剑's melee or into a group. Skill-test numbers were taken against a nearby dummy, so this never showed up.
confirmed.trigger: In the air with an enemy 25-35 m away, press Q (断月) or, while awakened, R (万剑归宗). 苍鸿 dashes most of the distance toward the target instead of firing from where he stands.
confirmed.fix: Treat proj moves as rooted. In kit_move (or _start_move), set `_rooted = _mv(id).has('proj')` after _start_move. In _tick_attack, while _rooted, only set face_yaw toward the target and leave drive_vel at 0, or a small fixed forward step if a lunge feel is wanted. Alternatively call kit_move with pick=false and t=null for the ranged skills, and let on_proj aim using pick_target().
confirmed.evidence: kit_canghong.gd:117 and :120 call kit_move('k_dy1'/'k_tz'/'k_wj', player.air.pick_target(), false, true). _pick_target reaches RUSH_R = 36 m (air_melee.gd:54, 1152-1157). kit_move (4482-4503) goes straight to _start_move, which resets _rooted = false (1406) and skips the MAGNET/rush gating in _begin_combo (1194-1207). _tick_attack (3057-3068) then pulls the caster toward the target with drive_vel = to/(hit_t-_t), capped at 80 m/s, until the hit (k_dy1/k_dy2 hit 0.08 s, k_tz 0.12 s, k_wj 0.55 s per hero_defs.gd:146-180). After the hit it keeps sticking at 22 m/s until 'end'. player._air applies air.drive_vel directly (player.gd:1473-1477). Per cast, 断月 moves the caster roughly 6.4 + 1.8 + 6.4 + 7 ≈ 20 m and 天斩 about 10 + 10 m. 万剑归宗 arrives point-blank. The projectile still fires and damage is unaffected, so this is a strong UX and role problem rather than a hard break. Downgraded from high to medium.

confirmed.title: New maps have no physics colliders, so projectiles, 剑气 and every warp ignore lab walls and terrain
confirmed.detail: Wall and terrain tests on the hero/combat side are all physics queries on layer 1: `_legal()` (shape plus ray, used by `safe_spot` for 瞬身, 瞬步, 一闪 `pass`, the 回风/剑域 warp behind the attacker, and air-combat swaps), the Wave ray in kit_canghong.gd:431-433, and the Proj ray in spell_projectile.gd:569-570. scripts/ex/* and block_world.gd create no StaticBody or collision shapes. The only collider is ex_level's 6×6 m `_floor` box under the player, and walls exist only as `world.solid_h` / `level.blocked()` data. So in 天工秘所: (a) 御剑 volleys, 点射, 剑诀, 飞剑阵 and 苍鸿's 断月/天斩/万剑归宗 fly through buildings and hit players inside them, and the 'crash into terrain or buildings' branch of Wave never fires; (b) `safe_spot` approves any landing point, so a 回风 counter or 一闪 pass against someone with their back to a wall teleports 苍鸿 into or through it (ex_level `_clip` then skips 'already inside a wall' cases); (c) melee hit checks have no line-of-sight test either. Ranged PvP in the lab ignores cover, which also tilts balance further toward 御剑.
confirmed.trigger: Lab: one player stands inside a building and a 御剑 outside holds E aimed at him, so the swords pass through the wall and deal damage. Or a 苍鸿 uses 回风 against an attacker standing in a doorway or against a wall, and 苍鸿 lands inside the wall or on its far side.
confirmed.fix: Add a static segment-block hook, e.g. `static var block_fn: Callable` on spell_projectile.gd, set by ex_level._ready to level.blocked and cleared in _exit_tree. Call it in Proj's per-step segment test (both straight and homing swords, impacting at the wall) and in Wave._process before _sweep. In air_melee._legal, also reject spots where `level.blocked(pivot, c)` or the spot is inside a solid box, via a similar AirMelee.legal_fn hook.
confirmed.evidence: Partly confirmed. Projectile and Wave wall tests are physics-only: spell_projectile.gd:569-576 (layer-1 ray) and kit_canghong.gd:431-437. Homing swords never test walls at all (spell_projectile.gd:542-554). _legal uses intersect_shape/intersect_ray on layer 1 (air_melee.gd:1356-1370), and its floor test is cam.floor_fn, which is terrain only. The only collider ex_level builds is the 6×6 m `_floor` box (ex_level.gd:159-165). block_world adds no StaticBody; walls exist only as world.solid_h / level.blocked. So on the new maps, swords and 断月/天斩 waves fly through buildings and hit players inside them, and the Wave 'crash into building' branch never fires. Part (b) is mostly refuted: ex_level._constrain sweeps every horizontal move under 6 m through _clip in 0.3 m steps in the same render frame (ex_level.gd:584-605, process_priority 10 after the player). The 回风/剑域 counter warp and the 一闪 pass both move only about 3-4 m, so they get clipped at the wall instead of going through. Projectiles ignoring buildings was already true in the legacy block-world raid. It matters more now because the lab is built around cover for PvP. Downgraded to medium.

confirmed.title: Legacy 木兰草原 LAN rooms carry the hub hero: other players see a 苍鸿 model with a sword on a legacy 阿拉灯 player
confirmed.detail: `_enter_level` runs the networking first (`_matchmake()` / `net.host()` / `net.join()`, lines ~897-917) and only then calls `_apply_combat_mode("legacy")` at line 931. `net.host()` (net.gd:177) records `players[1].hero = _my_hero()`, and `join()` (net.gd:205) sends `_hello(..., _my_hero())`. At that moment the player is still in hub hero mode, so the value is ExProfile.hero(), e.g. 'canghong'. remote_player `_ready` and `set_info` (lines 65-76, 124) then build that peer's puppet with the canghong skin and a sword (`_apply_hero`), although the player actually fights with legacy 阿拉灯 fists. SPEC 6.5 says door 0 = 御剑 with no overrides. The roster's `realm` is also 2 rather than the boot realm (unused today, but just as wrong).
confirmed.trigger: Two LAN players. One has picked 苍鸿 in the lobby. Both enter door 0 木兰草原 with 匹配/开房. Each side sees the 苍鸿 player as the 苍鸿 model holding a glowing sword while he punches with legacy moves.
confirmed.fix: In _enter_level, call `_apply_combat_mode('ex' if is_ex else 'legacy')` before the net.host / join / _matchmake block. set_hero('') plus set_realm only touch the player, so the order is safe. Separately, add a reliable 'my hero changed' RPC, or re-send roster info on player.hero_changed while net.active, so players[id].hero stays current (also covers H known issue 4).
confirmed.evidence: main.gd:264 and :1039 put the hub in hero mode (_apply_combat_mode('hub') → set_hero(ExProfile.hero())). In _enter_level, the match/host/join block (main.gd:898-920; _matchmake → net.join / net.host at 1002-1003) runs before `_apply_combat_mode('ex' if is_ex else 'legacy')` at main.gd:931. net.host records players[1].hero = _my_hero() (net.gd:177), join sends _hello(..., _my_hero()) (net.gd:205), and _my_hero reads player.hero_id (net.gd:337-341). The bug is visual only: hitboxes and damage are unaffected, and only players who picked 苍鸿 are hit. Downgraded to medium.

confirmed.title: Hits that are parried, blocked, vanished, dash-iframed or landed during 大罡剑阵 still drain 玄龟镜, 法宝 durability and interrupt read channels
confirmed.detail: For a PvP hit, `net_take_hit` applies `_pvp_clamp`, then `_absorb_shell(d)`, then `ExData.wear_chips(equip, d)` (10 durability per point), sets `_killer`, and sets `_hurt_mark = true`, all before `player.air.receive_attack` / `player.melee.receive_attack` decides the outcome. receive_attack then returns -1 (dash, `_iframe`, ult.active, CLASH/BRAWL, protected), 1 (护体: only 15% chip, or a free swat), or 2 (苍鸿 回风/剑域 parry, 瞬身). Mobs do the same through `atk_out` → `to_player_from` (lines 1090-1095, called at raid_mob.gd:873 before receive_attack). So a perfect parry or a swatted volley still uses up the 玄龟镜 shell, wears 法宝 durability as if the full hit landed (SPEC 3.4 wears per point of bar damage taken), and `_hurt_mark` cancels the extraction or box read ('挨了一下，读条被打断'). A 御剑 inside his 5 s invulnerable 大罡剑阵 loses shell and durability to every incoming hit, and 苍鸿's main defensive tool costs him gear.
confirmed.trigger: PvP: 苍鸿 with a 玄龟镜 (shell 12) and a 回元佩 uses 回风 and parries a 御剑 M1 (≈27 pts). No HP is lost, yet the shell drops to 0 and the 回元佩 loses about 150 durability. Or: hold 护体 and swat a 御剑 volley while channelling an extraction, and the read is cancelled and the chips lose durability for every sword swatted.
confirmed.fix: Resolve first, pay afterwards. Record hp0 = player.melee.hp, call receive_attack with the clamped/DR'd value, then compute lost = hp0 - player.melee.hp (or use the res code: only res == 0 is a real hit, and res == 1 guard chip is lost HP only). Apply the shell by refunding HP up to the shell amount after the fact, then wear_chips(equip, lost) and set _hurt_mark / _killer only when lost > 0. Refund _pvp_heat when res != 0. For the mob path, do the same in raid_mob._hit_player: call atk_out only to scale, and let the manager react to res, or move shell and _hurt_mark into a post-hit callback.
confirmed.evidence: extract_manager.gd:1239-1251, PvP path: _pvp_clamp (which also uses up the burst/sustain heat), then _absorb_shell(d), then ExData.wear_chips(equip, d) (10 durability per point, ex_data.gd:1356-1370), then _killer and _hurt_mark = true. All of this runs before player.air.receive_attack / player.melee.receive_attack (1258-1262) decides the outcome. receive_attack returns -1 for dash, _iframe, ult.active, dun, CLASH, BRAWL, _prot and DOWN (air_melee.gd:3542-3555). It returns 2 for a parry (3557-3561) or a 瞬身 (3574-3576), and 1 for a free ranged swat (3577-3579) or a guard that takes only 15% (3580-3600). The mob path does the same: raid_mob.gd:873-879 calls atk_out → to_player_from (extract_manager.gd:1090-1096), which absorbs shell and sets _hurt_mark before receive_attack, though it does not wear chips. _hurt_mark feeds `hurt` (1007), which cancels box/med reads (_update_channel 1310) and the extraction read (_update_extract 1480). That breaks SPEC 3.4 ('受到真人伤害时，每 1 点条上伤害扣 10 耐久') and SPEC 2xx ('挨打取消'): a perfect 回风 parry still empties the 玄龟镜, costs hundreds of 法宝 durability and cancels the extraction.

confirmed.title: Legacy regression: a late attack press after 绕身击 / 破空蹬 now restarts the chain at l1
confirmed.detail: `_begin_combo`'s link window gained the condition `and ATK.has(_last_id)`. In legacy, ATK = Moves.CHAIN [l1..l5], but `_last_id` can be a derive or dash move whose `next` points back into the chain: d_fl (绕身击) → l5 and dash (破空蹬) → l3 (air_moves.gd:55, 59). Before this change, an attack press within Moves.LINK = 0.45 s after those moves ended continued to l5 or l3. Now ATK.has('d_fl') / ATK.has('dash') is false, so the combo restarts at l1 (冲拳). The 'set_hero("") is unchanged' guarantee is broken for door 0 and the old demos, and the yujian hero is affected the same way. canghong's kd_fl → k4 and k_dash → k3 hit it too.
confirmed.trigger: Legacy 木兰草原 at 结丹 or above: l1 → l2 → push sideways (绕身击), let it finish, then press attack within 0.45 s. Before: 掣剑横斩 (l5). Now: 冲拳 (l1). Same with 御风突进 → 破空蹬 → late press, which should give l3.
confirmed.fix: Check the successor instead of the predecessor: `if _clock - _last_end <= Moves.LINK and _last_id != '': var nx := str(_mv(_last_id).get('next','')); if nx != '' and not JUG.has(nx) and ATK.has(nx): id = nx`. This keeps d_fl→l5, dash→l3, kd_fl→k4 and k_dash→k3, and still blocks stale links such as ka3→ka4 after the awakening ends or kit-skill 'next' ids.
confirmed.evidence: air_melee.gd:1180 now requires `ATK.has(_last_id)` (the backup had only `_last_id != ''`). In legacy, ATK = Moves.CHAIN [l1..l5], while _last_id can be 'd_fl' (next 'l5') or 'dash' (next 'l3') (air_moves.gd:55,59), set at air_melee.gd:3090 when the move ends. A press within LINK 0.45 s after the move ends reaches _begin_combo (via _consume at 901) and now starts l1 instead of l5/l3. Presses inside the move's own chain window still go through the queued `next` path at 3080-3087, so only late presses change. That makes this a minor feel regression for door 0, not a broken legacy world. Downgraded to low.

confirmed.title: 觉醒 剑域 counters only the first melee attacker; the advertised 'up to 4 counters in 1.6 s' never happens while the ring keeps showing
confirmed.detail: `start_parry(DOMAIN_T 1.6, DOMAIN_R 6, max_n 4)` puts the hero in GUARD, and `receive_attack` parries only when `parry_t > 0 and state == A.GUARD`. On the first success, `_parry_counter` leaves parry_t running for the domain but sets `state = A.IDLE; _start_move("k_ctr")`. After k_ctr (end 0.5 s), `_to_idle()` goes back to GUARD only if the 御 key is physically held (guard_held), and the domain is cast with Z. So the remaining ~1 s of the domain does nothing against melee (ranged swats still work), and parry_n never passes 1. The kit_canghong ring (lines 144-153) is freed only when parry_t reaches 0, so it stays on screen and tells the player the domain is still active.
confirmed.trigger: Awakened 苍鸿 presses Z (剑域) while two AI 修士 or players are attacking in melee. The first one is countered; the second hit about 0.6 s later lands normally even though the ring is still drawn.
confirmed.fix: In _parry_counter, when parry_r > 0 and parry_n < parry_max, set a flag (e.g. `_parry_resume = true`). In _to_idle, enter GUARD with rig.play(_pose('f_guard')) if `_parry_resume and parry_t > 0.0`, and clear the flag when parry_t reaches 0 or kit_move/start_parry runs. Alternatively end the domain after the first counter (set parry_t = 0) and fix the ring and descriptions to match.
confirmed.evidence: start_parry(1.6, 6, 4) (kit_canghong.gd:113; air_melee.gd:4507-4528) sets GUARD. receive_attack parries only when `parry_t > 0.0 and state == A.GUARD` (3557). On the first counter, _parry_counter keeps parry_t for the domain (4581-4582) but sets `state = A.IDLE; _start_move(pid)` (4586-4587). When k_ctr ends (end 0.5, hero_defs.gd:142), _to_idle (3200-3213) returns to GUARD only if guard_held, i.e. the physical 御 key, but the domain was cast with Z. The GUARD-state keep-alive at 2873-2875 never runs because the state is no longer GUARD. So parry_n never passes 1. Correction to the report: ranged swats ALSO stop after the first counter, since the ranged branch of _try_parry sits behind the same state == GUARD check. The ring stays visible because kit_canghong.gd:151 frees it only when _domain_t >= DOMAIN_T or parry_t <= 0. hero_selftest only tests a single domain counter (hero_selftest.gd:351-357).

confirmed.title: Hero lunges can tunnel through lab walls on a long frame (ex_level treats any move over 6 m in one frame as a teleport and skips wall clipping)
confirmed.detail: Walls in the new maps are enforced only in `_constrain()` (render frame) and `_physics_process`. Both skip clipping when the player moved more than 6 m (`warp := mv.length() > 6.0`) or 4 m (`warped`) in one frame. Hero moves exceed that easily: 一闪/瞬狱 with no target drive at `lunge_v` 100 m/s, and the attack magnet allows 150 m/s for lunge moves. The new per-frame limit `to.length()/dt` (air_melee.gd:3063) lets one frame cover the full distance to the target. At ≥60 ms per frame (≤16 fps, common on the mobile/web target), or on the multi-second first-use shader-compile hitches documented in P_fix §4, a single lunge step goes past 6 m and passes through the wall unclipped.
confirmed.trigger: Web or mobile build in the lab, no enemy within 14 m. 苍鸿 presses E facing a building wall 5-10 m away during a frame hitch (first 一闪 or 天斩 of the session compiles its shaders): the hero ends up inside or behind the wall. Same with a 一闪 at a target standing behind a wall.
confirmed.fix: Have teleports mark themselves explicitly instead of inferring them from distance. Add `player.warped_frame = Engine.get_process_frames()` (or a signal) in warp_to / respawn / doctor_warp / ex_level's own _tp paths, and in _constrain treat `warp` as that flag. Otherwise always run _clip, which already subdivides in 0.3 m steps, so long moves are safe. Optionally clamp combat drive travel per frame in ex mode (e.g. drive_vel.limit_length(4.0 / dt)).
confirmed.evidence: Air walls on new maps exist only in ex_level._constrain. It skips clipping when the per-frame horizontal move is over 6 m (ex_level.gd:583-585, `warp := mv.length() > 6.0`), and in the air _physics_process only lifts y (764-777). player._process applies velocity = air.drive_vel with move_and_slide using the unclamped process delta (player.gd:1471-1477; no dt clamp in player.gd). 一闪/瞬狱 with no target drive at lunge_v 100 m/s (air_melee.gd:3055-3056), so any frame of 60 ms or more moves over 6 m unclipped. With a target, approach runs about 86 m/s (to/(hit_t-t)) up to 150 m/s (3064), so frames of roughly 70 ms or more do the same. After tunneling, _clip lets the player walk out freely because 'already in wall → return to' (651-652). Correction: the new `to.length()/dt` cap (3066) does not cause this; it lowers per-frame travel compared with the pre-refactor 150 m/s cap. The root cause is ex_level's displacement-based warp heuristic. It needs ≤15 fps or a hitch, so it is an edge case.

confirmed.title: Every remote puppet, legacy included, loses the pose hop and hip-drop: `hero.position.y` is overwritten after rig.apply
confirmed.detail: `rig.apply(dt)` sets `hero.position = (0, (hop - drop·ak)·w_leg, 0)` (fighter_rig.gd:188). The new downed code then writes `hero.position.y = 0.28 * dk` unconditionally every frame, which is 0 when the peer isn't downed. Every remote puppet in every mode, including legacy 木兰草原 rooms and the hub arena, loses the hop of jump/kick poses (up to 0.4) and the hip drop of wide ground stances (ak = 1 by default, ≈0.1-0.2 m). Feet float above the ground in ground stances and jump kicks stay flat. The local player isn't affected because player.gd offsets body_root instead.
confirmed.trigger: LAN legacy raid: watch another player fight on the ground with player_melee stances or jump attacks. Their puppet floats a hand's width above the ground and never hops.
confirmed.fix: Apply the downed offset only while downed or still blending out, and additively: `if dk > 0.0001: hero.position.y += 0.28 * dk; hero.rotation.x = -1.42 * dk` with `elif _was_down: hero.rotation.x = 0.0; _was_down = false`. Or put the downed transform on `visual` (the parent) instead of `hero`.
confirmed.evidence: fighter_rig.apply sets `hero.position = Vector3(0, (hop - drop*ak)*lg, 0)` (fighter_rig.gd:188), or ZERO when the weights are 0 (149-151). remote_player._process calls rig.apply(dt) (remote_player.gd:226) and then unconditionally writes `hero.position.y = 0.28 * dk` and `hero.rotation.x = -1.42 * dk` (229-230). The backup has no such lines. When not downed, dk = 0, so every remote puppet, legacy rooms and hub included, loses the jump/kick hop and the ground-stance hip drop every frame. The local player is unaffected.

confirmed.title: Ground-path downing plays the 'reappear' respawn burst (and a slow-mo) as you go down
confirmed.detail: When the lethal hit lands on the ground, player_melee `_on_hurt` first does `_enter(M.DOWN)` and `Combat.slowmo(0.2, 0.3, 0.5)`, then emits player_dead. `_on_own_event` converts this to downed and calls `melee.revive()`, which, because state == M.DOWN, runs `Vfx.reappear(player.center(), …)` and `_to_ready()` before hp is set back to 1. Every ground knock-down therefore shows the respawn 'reappear' effect at the moment the player falls, plus the death slow-mo, which reads as 'you revived' rather than 'you are downed'.
confirmed.trigger: New map: stand on the ground at low HP and take a lethal mob or PvP hit (ground path, not air). A respawn burst plays while the 重伤 pose starts.
confirmed.fix: Give revive an fx flag (`func revive(fx := true)`, and only call Vfx.reappear when fx is true) and call melee.revive(false) from _on_own_event. Also call Combat.slowmo_release(0.1) there so the death slow-mo does not play over a downing.
confirmed.evidence: On a ground kill, player_melee._on_hurt does _enter(M.DOWN), rig.play('down'), player.dead = true, Combat.slowmo(0.2, 0.3, 0.5), then emits player_dead (player_melee.gd:1106-1113). player._on_own_event (player.gd:624-636) turns that into a downing and calls melee.revive(). revive() (player_melee.gd:517-522) runs Vfx.reappear(player.center(), _col()) and _to_ready() because state == M.DOWN. So every ground downing plays the respawn burst plus the death slow-mo just as the 重伤 pose starts.

confirmed.title: PvP volley reduction depends on the aim target, not on who is actually hit
confirmed.detail: `_vol_pvp` is true only when this frame's `_pick()` returned a player puppet. With no target in the 45 m auto-aim cone (or with the camera locked on a boss), volley swords are launched `straight` and hit anything on their path through `Proj._sweep`, including enemy players, at the full 0.5 u per sword instead of 0.275 u. Swords fly 72 m/s × 1.3 s ≈ 94 m, so a target 45-94 m away takes 1.8× the intended PvP volley damage, and so does a player standing in the line of fire while the 御剑 shoots a boss.
confirmed.trigger: A 御剑 holds E toward an enemy player 60 m away (outside AIM_RANGE). The untargeted straight swords hit that player for 4.5 pts each instead of 2.5.
confirmed.fix: Tag volley projectiles (opts 'volley': true, raw per-sword dmg unscaled) and apply PVP_VOLLEY_K where the hit resolves on a puppet, e.g. in remote_player.receive_hit / net_deal_hit when info.volley is set and the shooter is in hero mode. Drop the spawn-time _vol_pvp scaling.
confirmed.evidence: _vol_pvp is set from the aim target each channel frame (air_caster.gd:259) and applied when the sword is spawned (470). With no target within 45 m (58.5 m for a recent attacker, Proj.pick_target spell_projectile.gd:250-260; there is no cone), _volley_fan/_volley_form launch `straight` swords (air_caster.gd:350-351, 426) that live 1.3 s at 72-96 m/s. Straight non-ghost swords _sweep every target on their path (spell_projectile.gd:572), so an enemy player at 45-94 m takes the full non-PvP per-sword value (about 1.8× the intended PvP value). Correction: the 'player in the line of fire while shooting a boss' case is wrong. Homing swords never sweep and only impact their own target (spell_projectile.gd:542-554). The gain is also bounded by PVP_SUSTAIN 25/s and poor long-range accuracy.

confirmed.title: Big map (layer 30) stays open over the result page and the downed panel
confirmed.detail:
No code path closes the level's full-screen big map when the player goes down or the raid ends. `_extract_done` (1550), `_die` (1566) and `player_downed` (1158) only call `_close_bag()`. The BigMap CanvasLayer is layer 30 and ex_hud is layer 12, so the result page and the 自救/自尽 paper are drawn underneath the map.
- Touch: BigMap._gui_input calls accept_event on every tap inside its panel. On a phone the panel covers x≈412..1288 × 12..888, which contains the 自救 button, so taps on 自救 are swallowed.
- Desktop: pressing M to close the map runs `close_big_map()` (ex_level.gd:1156), which forces MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED. ex_hud._sync_mouse only acts on edges and `_mouse_free` is already true, so it never frees the cursor again. 自救 / 回主城 can't be clicked until the player presses Esc.
- ex_level._exit_tree calls close_big_map while is_inside_tree() is still true, so it also re-captures the mouse during the exit fade.
confirmed.trigger:
1) Stand in an extract zone and open the map (tap the minimap or press M) to check teammates while the 5 s read finishes. The result page renders under the map, and the HUD/manager auto-return after 4.5 s, so the player never sees 撤离成功, the loot list or the rank-up. Dying with the map open hides the 身死道消 / 失去 list the same way.
2) Get downed while the map is open. On a phone, tapping 自救 does nothing; on desktop, M to close the map then clicking 自救 does nothing because the mouse is captured.
confirmed.fix:
- Close the map in the manager: add `if level != null and level.has_method("close_big_map"): level.close_big_map()` in the player_downed branch, `_extract_done` and `_die`.
- In ex_level.open_big_map, return early when `raid != null and (bool(raid.downed) or not (raid.result as Dictionary).is_empty())`.
- Make ex_hud._sync_mouse self-heal only in the 'want free' direction: `if want and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED: Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE`, checked every frame. Don't force-capture every frame, or Esc-to-free stops working.
- Alternatively, have close_big_map skip the capture when `raid != null and (raid.downed or raid.hud.bag_open())`.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. extract_manager.gd:1158 (player_downed), 1550 (_extract_done) and 1566 (_die) call only _close_bag(); nothing calls level.close_big_map(). ex_level.gd:1139 puts BigMap on layer 30, and ex_hud.gd:293 puts the HUD on layer 12. BigMap (minimap.gd:503-504) is a full-rect MOUSE_FILTER_STOP control that draws an opaque scroll panel over the centre, so the result page and downed paper sit underneath it. open_big_map has no downed or result guard (ex_level.gd:1135). M still reaches ex_level._unhandled_input while downed, because ex_hud._modal() is bag/result only (ex_hud.gd:623-624, 670). The worst part is desktop: close_big_map (ex_level.gd:1156-1157) forces MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED. ex_hud._sync_mouse (687-699) is edge-triggered on the cached _mouse_free, which is already true while downed, so it never frees the cursor again. The downed player then can't click 自救, which has no key binding (ex_hud.gd:462), until they discover Esc (camera_rig.gd:280-281). Closing with 合上 or by clicking outside the panel goes through the same close_big_map. On the result page Esc is also swallowed (ex_hud.gd:670-673), and the result auto-returns after RESULT_T 4.5 s (extract_manager.gd:46), usually before the player has closed the map. One correction: the phone part is not a real bug. The map visibly covers 自救, and 合上 or a tap outside the panel closes it with no cursor problem, because _sync_mouse returns early on touch. The _exit_tree re-capture is harmless.

confirmed.title: Touches go through the big map to the joystick, camera and combat buttons on mobile
confirmed.detail:
BigMap is not in the "touch_ui" group. `main._level_bag_open()` (main.gd:805, which feeds touch.blocked at main.gd:1186) only asks `hud.bag_open()`. touch_controls._touch_down tests its own buttons first, then touch_ui controls, then starts the stick (left 42% of the screen) or camera-look. So with the big map up, every tap also drives the player.

On a 1701×900 phone layout the map panel spans x 412..1288:
- The hero Q button (HERO_POS summon, vs+(-480,-130) = (1221,770), r≈60) sits inside the map's lower-right corner.
- 诀 at (1311,645) and the hero R at (1306,490) straddle the panel's right border.
- Tapping right of the panel to close the map lands on 御 (1366,795), 攻 (1536,735), 闪 or 剑, and fires them in the same tap (the emulated mouse event still reaches BigMap and closes it).
- Taps on the map's left half start the joystick; drags rotate the camera.
confirmed.trigger: On phone/web, while in air combat, open the big map and tap the lower-right of the map: the Q skill (断月 / 飞剑阵) is cast and costs MP and cooldown. Or close the map by tapping the empty area to its right: the player attacks, dashes or guards.
confirmed.fix: In main._level_bag_open(), also return true when `level.has_method("big_map_open") and bool(level.call("big_map_open"))`. touch_controls then releases everything and ignores touches while the map is up. BigMap keeps working through the emulated mouse events, the same way the bag panel does while blocked. Don't fold the map into ex_hud.bag_open() instead: that makes ex_hud._input swallow M (ex_hud.gd:670-673), so M could no longer close the map. Adding BigMap to touch_ui is optional and does not stop the buttons on its own.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. touch_controls._input (touch_controls.gd:206-217) handles every ScreenTouch before the GUI does and returns early only when `blocked`. `blocked` is set at main.gd:1186 from _level_bag_open(), which only asks hud.bag_open() (main.gd:805-812), and bag_open() is bag or result (ex_hud.gd:599-600). The big map is never considered. _touch_down tests its own BUTTONS first (248-264), then touch_ui controls (265-272), then stick or look (273-290). BigMap is not in touch_ui; the only members are ex_hud's own controls. BigMap still gets the emulated mouse click separately (minimap.gd:523-529), so one tap both closes or uses the map and fires the button underneath. Geometry: the panel is a square of side min(w,h)-24, centred (minimap.gd:533-534). Hero Q sits at vs+(-480,-130) with r52 (touch_controls.gd:51, 136-137), which falls inside the panel's lower-right on 16:9 screens while airborne. 攻/御/闪/飞 sit in the right strip outside the panel, exactly where a player taps to close the map, so closing can attack, guard, dash or jump. Note the finding's first fix (adding BigMap to touch_ui) does nothing for the buttons, because BUTTONS are tested before the group.

confirmed.title: The 'ex' warmup runs once per session, so the second map gets no prewarm
confirmed.trigger: Web build: hub → gate 2 (desert) → extract → gate 3 (lab). The [warm] line is absent for the lab load. The first night horde, first gel mutant, first curtain view and so on hitch while playing. Same for 苍鸿 first raid → switch to 御剑 → first 大罡剑阵.

Split the ex pass:

confirmed.title: Box MultiMeshes draw every box of the map in all six state meshes, never culled
confirmed.detail:
`_setup_boxes` makes six MultiMeshes (3 kinds × open/closed), each with `instance_count = _boxes.size()`. Every box has an instance in all six. The five that don't match are hidden by moving them to y = −5000 (`_box_visual`, line 1706).

Because the MultiMesh AABB includes those hidden instances and the boxes from the whole map, the AABB is map-wide and 5 km tall. There is no visibility_range either. So the MultiMesh is never frustum- or distance-culled, and every instance is vertex-shaded every frame. The meshes are non-indexed `RaidData.add_box`: 12 tris / 36 verts per box.
- Closed meshes: weapon 84 + supply 96 + med 96 tris → 276 tris per box index, drawn from the first frame. That is lab 131 × 276 ≈ 36k tris; desert ≈ 21.5k.
- Once one box of each kind has been opened, the three open meshes (84 + 108 + 84) are no longer all at −5000 and are drawn too: up to lab ≈ 72k tris / 217k verts per frame, desert ≈ 43k.
- Useful geometry is about 131 × 95 ≈ 12k tris for the whole map, and only ~2–3k within ~150 m.
- On desktop the boxes also cast shadows, so the whole set is drawn again in the shadow passes.
confirmed.trigger: Lab on the web tier after opening a weapon, a supply and a med box: roughly 72k of the 220k primitive budget is box geometry, most of it at y = −5000 or across the map. E's accounting only counted the 3 draw calls, not primitives.
confirmed.fix:
Cheapest step: give each kind its own pair of MultiMeshes, with instance_count equal to the number of boxes of that kind and a box→slot map. Each box then lives in 2 meshes instead of 6, which cuts the lab from about 72k to about 24k tris.

Next, compact within each kind: keep open and closed boxes in separate ranges, using swap-with-last plus `visible_instance_count`, and update on the rare state changes (open, 180 s reset, door open). That brings it to about 12k.

Also:
- Call `st.index()` before `commit()` in _box_mesh.
- Optionally bucket by 96 m cells with `visibility_range_end` around 160 m. A range on one map-wide MMI is useless, because it is measured to the AABB.
- Never park hidden instances far away: it also destroys frustum culling.
confirmed.evidence:
Confirmed. extract_manager.gd:1645-1661 builds six MultiMeshes, each with `instance_count = _boxes.size()`, so every box is in every mesh. _box_visual (1702-1710) parks the five non-matching copies at BOX_HIDE (0,-5000,0) (1699). A MultiMesh AABB covers all instances, so each AABB spans the map plus 5 km down. The box MMIs set no visibility_range, while the other cull_far users do (919-925). So any of the six meshes that has a real instance on screen is drawn with all of its instances, and the GPU processes every instance's vertices.

The mesh sizes match the finding: _box_mesh (1714-1768) builds non-indexed add_box geometry (raid_data.gd:373-392, 36 verts per box): 7/8/8 boxes closed and 7/9/7 open. The lab has 131 boxes (E_core.md:63). That is about 36k tris always, and about 72k once one box of each kind has been opened, against about 12k of real geometry. I_int §5.2 counted only the box draw calls (1~14). Its primitive totals for lab boss, loot and extract (245k–280k against a 220k budget, I_int.md:228) include this waste.

confirmed.title: Loot cards are torn down and rebuilt whenever the nearest-first order changes, dropping taps
confirmed.detail:
The manager re-sorts `cards` by distance every 0.1 s (extract_manager.gd:2016). The HUD signature includes the key order, so any swap calls `_rebuild_cards`. That frees every card Button and builds new ones: about 8 cards × ~10 nodes plus 4 PaperBox each.

Buttons emit `pressed` on release. If a rebuild lands between touch-down and touch-up, the pressed card is already freed and the tap is lost. The same rebuild cancels a scroll drag, resets the list, and makes cards jump around.
confirmed.trigger: Open a supply box (2–4 items spray 1.2–2.4 m around it), or stand in a boss-loot scatter. Hold the joystick to walk between the items while tapping a card with the other thumb. The distances cross, the order flips every few hundred ms, and some taps do nothing while the cards visibly reshuffle.
confirmed.fix:
Keep display order stable: put a sorted (order-insensitive) key set in `_card_sig`, and refresh only `_top_key` (the T target) and the text each tick.

If nearest-first display is wanted, do it incrementally: keep a key → Button map, add or remove only changed keys, reorder with move_child, and skip reordering while a card is pressed (`Button.button_pressed` / `is_pressed()`) or the scroll is dragging.

Optionally add 0.5 m hysteresis to the manager's sort.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. The manager rebuilds `cards` every 0.1 s (extract_manager.gd:1023-1026), sorted by distance (2016). The HUD signature includes the per-card key order (ex_hud.gd:887-893), so any reorder calls _rebuild_cards. That function `remove_child`s and frees every card Button (910-913) and builds new ones (918-935). The cards are plain Buttons with the default ACTION_MODE_BUTTON_RELEASE (931). If a rebuild lands between press and release, the pressed node is gone, `pressed` never fires and the tap is lost. A ScrollContainer drag is also interrupted, because the children are replaced. This needs the player to move: pickups are static once landed, so distances only cross while walking among several items within PICK_R 3.6 m. That is common while looting a supply spray or a boss scatter with the stick held.

confirmed.title: New large font sizes each create an extra 1024² glyph cache on web
confirmed.detail:
The web-memory note says every (font, size ≥ 65, outline) combination allocates its own 1024² glyph-cache texture set (GPU copy + engine copy). Other code was already unified to 96 / outline 14 for this reason (hub plaques, level_portal, spar_zone).
- `ExBoss.countdown_label` uses the main font at font_size 72 with outline 14. That is a new combination, used by every summon altar and boss respawn countdown.
- ex_hud's result title uses `UiStyle.brush()` at 80 (ex_hud.gd:1273). That is also new: realm_broadcast already uses brush at 72 (58 × 1.25).

confirmed.fix:
- countdown_label: font_size 96, pixel_size 0.009 (same world size as 72 × 0.012), outline 14, so it shares the portal / spar cache. Pass the same font object they use.
- Result title: use the same size realm_broadcast resolves to on that viewport (int(58*k), or a shared constant).
confirmed.evidence:
Confirmed:
- ExBoss.countdown_label uses font_size 72 with outline_size 14 and the manager's main font (ex_boss.gd:341-344, called from extract_manager.gd:2904/3115/3137). The portal and spar labels use 96 / outline 14 (level_portal.gd:195-198, spar_zone.gd:108-111), so this is a new combination.
- The result title is brush at 80 (ex_hud.gd:1273-1274). realm_broadcast uses brush at int(58*k) with k = vs.y/720 (realm_broadcast.gd:39, 74), which is 72 on a 900-high viewport. 80 is a new combination.
The project's own web-memory note records that each (font, size ≥ 65, outline) set allocates its own 1024² glyph textures, a GPU copy plus an engine copy. That is a few MB each, never freed, on a build that phone browsers kill on memory.

After every extraction or death on desktop the player is back in the hub with a free cursor. The camera ignores mouse motion until they click the 3D view once (camera_rig re-captures on click).

confirmed.evidence:
Confirmed:

confirmed.title: ex_hud re-themes labels every frame, forcing text reshaping and container re-sort
confirmed.detail:
`_layout_top` calls `add_theme_color_override` on `_time_lab` and `_time_cap` every frame (767–768), and on `_doc_lab` every frame while it is visible (777). `_tick_downed` does the same to `_down_sec` (1023).

add_theme_color_override has no equality check: it sends NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED, which re-shapes the Label and calls update_minimum_size, re-sorting the `_info` PanelContainer chain every frame. P_fix explicitly removed this pattern from hud.gd ("每帧 add_theme_color_override 会让 Label 重排"). ex_hud also calls `_info.reset_size()` / `_loot_wrap.reset_size()` every frame.
confirmed.trigger: Any frame in a raid: CJK text shaping on the single-threaded web build, plus layout passes for the info plaque, every frame for the whole 15 minutes.
confirmed.fix: Cache the last colors, or follow hud._ink_key: `if lab.get_theme_color("font_color") != c: lab.add_theme_color_override("font_color", c)` for _time_lab, _time_cap, _doc_lab and _down_sec. Call _info.reset_size() only when one of its label texts changed.
confirmed.evidence:
Confirmed:
- _layout_top calls add_theme_color_override on _time_lab and _time_cap every frame with an unchanged color (ex_hud.gd:767-768), and on _doc_lab every frame while it is visible (777).
- _tick_downed does the same on _down_sec every downed frame (1023).
- _info.reset_size() runs every frame (778).
Control.add_theme_color_override has no equality check. It fires THEME_CHANGED, which marks the Label's font dirty and updates the minimum size. The project already fixed this exact pattern in hud.gd with _ink_key (hud.gd:502-507), whose comment says "每帧 add_theme_color_override 会让 Label 重排". confirmed.title: Every tap in the lobby rebuilds the whole page (up to 120 tiles on the 仓库 tab)
confirmed.detail:
`_select` (and every action) calls `_refresh()`, which `queue_free`s all `_body` children and rebuilds the page.
- On the 仓库 tab that is `stash_cap` (up to 90) + 30 bag tiles = 120 ExItemView.tile, each a Button + 4 PaperBox + _Rim + TextureRect + 1–2 Labels, so about 600 nodes and about 500 StyleBoxes recreated and re-shaped per tap.
- At about 6 batches per tile (see uxperf-8), the stash page also draws several hundred calls while the 3D hub keeps rendering behind the 0.72 dim.
confirmed.trigger: Phone web build with a max-level warehouse: open 洞府 → 仓库 and tap items to move them. Each tap causes a visible hitch (hundreds of controls rebuilt on the single thread) and the page runs far over the draw budget.
confirmed.fix:
- On selection change, restyle only the previously and newly selected tiles: keep a `src:i` → Button map and swap the normal stylebox / _Rim.selected.
- Rebuild only the affected grid on data changes (move, sell, buy).
- Optionally stop 3D rendering behind the full-screen lobby.
confirmed.evidence:
Confirmed:
- _select always calls _refresh (ex_lobby_ui.gd:365-372). _refresh hides and frees every _body child and rebuilds the whole tab (314-335).
- On the 仓库 tab, _fill_grid builds stash_cap tiles plus bag tiles (407-412, 520). stash_cap goes up to 90 (ex_data.gd:931 WAREHOUSE).
- Each ExItemView.tile is a Button with several styleboxes and child controls.
So every tap re-creates over 100 tiles. This only happens in a paused menu, so it shows as a per-tap hitch on web, not a gameplay problem.

confirmed.title: Each 断月 / 天斩 wave rebuilds its crescent mesh and material from scratch in GDScript
confirmed.detail: `Wave._ready` calls `_crescent()` for every wave. That builds a 432-vertex mesh with about 1,300 SurfaceTool calls (set_color / add_vertex) in GDScript and commits a new ArrayMesh, plus a new StandardMaterial3D. Q fires two waves, the awakened Q fires a giant one, and every remote player's wave runs the same path through `remote_wave`. Only two shapes exist (small and giant), and color is the only per-cast difference.
confirmed.trigger: Phone web build, 苍鸿 spamming Q in a fight (or several remote 苍鸿 players): a few ms of main-thread mesh building per cast on top of combat frames.
confirmed.fix: Cache the mesh in a static dictionary keyed by (giant, color.to_html()). Or build two white-vertex-color meshes once and tint through `_mat.albedo_color`, keeping the alpha ramp in the vertex alpha. The per-wave material is fine to keep, or cache it by color too.
confirmed.evidence: Confirmed. Wave._ready builds a new crescent mesh for every wave (kit_canghong.gd:355-369). _crescent (375-421) loops 18 segments × 2 quads × 12 vertices, so 432 vertices and 864 SurfaceTool set_color/add_vertex calls in GDScript, plus a new StandardMaterial3D, every wave including remote ones. Only two shapes exist (r/h for normal and giant). Color is the only other input, through vertex colors. That is roughly 1–2 ms per wave on the single-threaded web build, and Q fires two.

gaps.title: Gate 0 (木兰草原 旧版) keeps the whole dropped cultivation loop reachable from the hub, with a second 灵石 wallet
gaps.detail: Gate 0 is still open (hub_hall.gd:71) and runs MeadowLevel in legacy mode (main._apply_combat_mode('legacy'): set_hero(''), set_realm(Profile.boot_realm())). Its entry page opens the old abode_ui (level_select.gd:339-343), which has 储物 / 坊市 / 丹房 tabs (丹房 crafts 修为丹 / 破境丹). Abode.summary (abode_ui.gd:576-581) shows the OLD Profile.lingshi, so the player now has two different balances both called 灵石: the hub plate shows ExProfile, the gate 0 page shows the legacy Profile. Inside the raid, raid_manager / raid_hud still run 心得→修为, 服用 / 一键服丹 (raid_hud.gd:35, raid_manager.gd:117), the 破境丹 bottleneck and 雷劫 (raid_manager.gd:820,1044), and a breakthrough to 元婴 plays the 结婴 cutscene (player.gd:644). SPEC §0.5 lists 结婴演出触发 as removed. Combat there scales with the legacy realm, so a 苍鸿 pick silently reverts to the old 御剑. Case for KEEPING it: SPEC §0 and §10 explicitly defer converting it; it is the largest content in the game (a 3456 m loop world); legacy saves and LAN 40-player rooms live there; it shows off the air combat. Case for REMOVING or HIDING it: the user asked to remove gameplay unrelated to extraction and dropped pill-eating / idle cultivation; it is the most prominent gate (leftmost, green); the two wallets and realm-scaled combat contradict the flat hero balance.
gaps.trigger: Start on a new save → in the hub walk into the green leftmost gate 木兰草原 · 旧版大世界 → the entry page shows 洞府 N 灵石 from the old save while the plate says 灵石 100万 → open 洞府 · 备战 → the 丹房 tab crafts 修为丹 → enter the raid → kill mobs (心得 orbs), use 服用 on 修为丹, reach the bottleneck → 雷劫 / 结婴 cutscene.
gaps.fix: Short term: for normal play set gate 0 to open:false ('旧版 · 封存'), and keep it reachable only under Profile.test_mode() so --raid-shot regression still works. At minimum, strip the 丹房 tab and the 服用 / 一键服丹 actions and hide the old 灵石. Next round: rebuild 木兰草原 as the DarkArea 市中心 analog (map 1 rules: junior*/mid* tables, no sellable loss on death, no downed state, ExProfile economy). That also gives new players a low-risk first raid.

gaps.title: No quick-use bar: healing and throwing a 符 mid-fight requires opening the modal bag
gaps.detail: Natural regen is off in both new maps (regen_k = 0), so 药 are the only heal and 符 the only throwables. The only way to use either is Tab / B (or the small touch bag button) → tap the item → tap 使用. ex_hud._input (653-676) only handles Tab / B / Esc, and ui_use is called only from the bag panel's _act (line 1177). While the bag is open the player takes no move or attack input, but the world keeps running (the tree is not paused). DarkArea uses an 8-slot 快捷栏 for meds, grenades and keys (DarkAreaFightMgr.lua:1266 ShortcutStartIndex..+7; KeyHouseMgr also checks the Shortcut bar). SPEC §3.5 itself suggested 快捷栏一键. TSB-style fighting expects the hands to stay on the fight.
gaps.trigger: At a 天工秘所 mob camp with HP 30/100: press Tab → a full-screen panel opens while the 尸傀 keep hitting → tap 金疮药 → 使用 → the bag closes → a 4 s channel starts and is interrupted by the next hit. On touch the same takes 3 taps plus a reach to the top-right bag button.
gaps.fix: Add 2-3 quick slots to ex_hud (best 药 / first 符 / 强心丹). Desktop: keys 1/2/3 or H. Touch: one small 药 button beside 御, plus a 符 button shown only when a 符 is in the bag. Each calls mgr.ui_use(index of first matching bag entry). Keep the bag for inventory management.

gaps.title: No auto-pickup (DarkAreaAutoPick not ported): every dropped item is a separate card tap or T press
gaps.detail: Boxes spray 1-4 single items on the ground, and bosses scatter 16 (凌幽) to 48 (铁穹双卫) single items across the arena. Each item needs ui_card via a card tap or T (pick_nearest only takes cards[0]); the card list holds at most 8 entries, about 4 visible on mobile. DarkArea ships a toggleable auto-pickup that collects on collision, filtered by category (枪械 / 药品 / 装备 / 售卖物 / 材料) × quality (UICom/DarkAreaAutoPick.lua). On a mobile-first build this is the most repeated action of the loop.
gaps.trigger: Solo on touch, kill 铁穹双卫 → 48 items spread over the ~26 m arena → about 48 separate walk-and-tap actions with the 900 s timer running. A medical box opened next to a fight also needs taps on each item.
gaps.fix: Add an auto-pick toggle with filters to ex_hud (default: 售卖物 ≥ 卓越, 药 / 符 / 钥匙, 法宝). Each tick, for Drops within about 1.5 m that match the filter and fit in the bag, call pick_up (LAN still goes through _claim). Also add a 拾取附近全部 card when ≥3 drops are within 4 m.

gaps.title: Player-plate portrait goes blank after any hero switch
gaps.detail: _draw_avatar bakes _vp.get_texture() into the canvas item (line 263). _rebuild_shot (349-356) frees the old SubViewport and builds a new one but never calls _av.queue_redraw(). The avatar is redrawn only when the rank badge or the mode changes, so it keeps drawing the freed viewport's texture: a blank paper circle. Evidence: _shots/preview/hero_canghong_m1.jpg, hero_touch_canghong_1.jpg and hero_touch_switch_canghong.jpg all show a blank avatar for 苍鸿; hero_touch_switch_yujian.jpg is still blank after switching back to 御剑; hero_yujian_m1.jpg (before any switch) shows the portrait.
gaps.trigger: Fresh save (段位 未入流, so the badge stays '' and never forces a redraw) → 洞府 → 英雄 → 选用 苍鸿 → the top-left portrait turns into an empty circle and stays that way through hub and raids until the first rank-up or a trip to gate 0.
gaps.fix: In _rebuild_shot, call _av.queue_redraw() after _build_shot(). Also queue a redraw in _set_look whenever it switches the viewport to UPDATE_ONCE.

gaps.title: Hero skill bar, cooldowns and awakening meter only exist while airborne
gaps.detail: hud._refresh_air sets _sk_root.visible = (p.st == AIR), so on the ground the four E/Z/Q/R boxes, their cooldowns and the 觉醒 % / 按住聚气 meter are hidden. touch_controls._btn_on (line 162) likewise hides all four hero skill buttons unless the player is airborne. In the new maps players spawn, walk, open boxes and fight ground mobs on foot, and the kits fire from the ground anyway (the kit auto-launches). TSB keeps the 4-skill hotbar and the awakening bar on screen at all times. ex_desert_spawn_gl.jpg shows the first-raid view: only 攻 / 御 / 闪 / 飞, no hint that 瞬 / 回 / 月 / 刃 or an awakening exist.
gaps.trigger: First raid on mobile as 苍鸿: walk from spawn to a box and fight a scorpion camp on foot → no skill buttons or awakening meter appear until something knocks you airborne or you tap 攻 and get launched.
gaps.fix: In hero mode (player.hero_id != ''), show the 4 skill boxes and touch buttons with cooldown rings, plus the awakening meter, regardless of p.st. Keep 御剑 R gated on btn_visible(3). Optionally dim them when no target is near, to respect the no-clutter rule.

gaps.title: Hero choice is invisible in the play flow (no picker or display on the entry page, no first-run choice)
gaps.detail: The entry page's loadout line comes from ExLobby.summary() (983-996), which lists weapon / armor / chips / bag / 灵石 but not the hero. The entry page has no way to change hero. New saves are silently 御剑, with no prompt. The only place to pick is the 6th tab of the 洞府 lobby, behind the top-right pouch button or the warehouse / shop buildings; the hub has no hero stand. The user's headline ask, 'players pick heroes', never appears on the path gate → 入境 → 开始匹配 (see ex_desert_gate2_entry.jpg).
gaps.trigger: New player walks into gate 2: the entry page shows 青锋剑·史诗 法衣 4/4 … 100万 灵石 → 开始匹配. They play several raids without learning that 苍鸿 exists.
gaps.fix: Put '英雄 X' and a 换英雄 button (cycles HeroDefs.ids() via ExProfile.set_hero + player.set_hero, or opens the lobby on the hero tab) into the entry-page loadout row. The first time ex_profile is created, open a 2-card hero picker (or the 英雄 tab) before the first raid.

gaps.title: Hub / 试剑台 training dummies show damage on the legacy 修为 (Hammer 万) scale in hero mode
gaps.detail: EnemyDummy.shown_dmg (123-130) converts damage through legacy Profile.cult(realm) and CS.unit_same(lv). hud._combo_ratio uses the same function in the hub. So hero hits on the hub and 试剑台 dummies float '1.396万', '2.302万' and '伤害 X万' (hero_canghong_m1.jpg, hero_yujian_m1.jpg). In the raids the same hit is about 5-15 points on a 100-point bar, against mobs with 40 / 80 HP. The training ground is where players learn the kits, but its numbers come from a dropped progression and vary with old 修为.
gaps.trigger: Pick 苍鸿 → go to 试剑台 → M1 a 木人 → numbers in 万. Then enter 沙海古墟 → the same M1 does about 6 points to a 40 HP scorpion.
gaps.fix: When player.hero_on(), show raw / player.hero_base() * 10 (the raid PvE unit, HIT_PER_UNIT), or PvP bar points, for both dummy floaters and _combo_ratio.

gaps.title: Other players and AI are labelled with legacy realm / 修为 levels, and hub presence never shows heroes
gaps.detail: In the hub, LAN presence puppets are tagged '名字 结丹 Lv.N' (Realm name + legacy 修为 lv), and the presence packet has no hero field, so every colleague renders as the default 阿拉灯 / 御剑 even if they picked 苍鸿 (lobby_hub_plate.jpg shows these tags). arena_duel takes lv = Profile.cult(...) (line 227), shows '结丹 Lv.N' in its HUD (924-925), and still applies arena_adv from legacy 修为 lv. In the new maps, remote_player.gd:169, air_foe and ally tags all read 'Lv.1'. DarkArea head boards show name + rank title.
gaps.trigger: Two colleagues on LAN in the hub; A picks 苍鸿 → B sees A as 阿拉灯 labelled '结丹 Lv.7'. Stepping onto the 擂台 shows '结丹 Lv.7' vs '结丹 Lv.7'.
gaps.fix: Append hero id and rank index to the lan_presence packet, keeping it tolerant of old 15-field packets, and label puppets '名字 · 苍鸿 · 筑基三阶' with the matching skin. In arena_duel, when CS.heroes_on, use lv = 1 and show the hero name. Drop 'Lv.N' from remote / AI tags in ex maps.

gaps.title: Hub still advertises 灵田农场 and 修炼场, which now silently do nothing
gaps.detail: The farm archway keeps its plaque '灵田农场' (1113-1123) and stays walk-through with no effect or message (_check_portals returns because farm == null). SPEC §7 asked to seal it and retitle it 「灵田 · 暂闭」. The 修炼场 plaque (1109) and its glowing meditation pads also remain, but standing on them does nothing now that _zone() no longer returns 'med'. Both are prominent dead ends next to the shop and warehouse.
gaps.trigger: Walk east through the pink-lit 灵田农场 archway → nothing happens, no text. Walk onto the 修炼场 pads → no button, no hint.
gaps.fix: Retitle the plaque to 灵田 · 暂闭, add a solid blocker and say('灵田 · 暂闭') on approach. Remove the 修炼场 plaque and pads, or repurpose the spot (for example as a hero-select stand or 试招台).

gaps.title: Desert nights have no extra spawns (DarkArea adds a monster round every 90 s at night in every war zone)
gaps.detail: map_def gives the desert horde = {}, so night in 沙海古墟 only changes the lighting. DarkArea's OnTurnToNight (DarkAreaFightMgr.lua:1181-1190) starts RandomSpawnMonster every 90 s for every player in any war zone, desert included, with desertmonsterDrops. The port drops that night pressure (more danger, more loot) from one of the two maps. This follows SPEC §4.9, but SPEC deviates from the reference here.
gaps.trigger: Stay in the desert past room time 600 s: lighting turns to night, but mob density and loot flow are identical to day.
gaps.fix: Give the desert a horde entry (interval 90, kinds scorpion / wolf_sand, 2-3 per wave, cap about 10), dropping as normal mobs (25% roll on desertmonsterDrops).

gaps.title: AI rivals, AI teammates and the arena sparring AI never use the hero system
gaps.detail: air_foe (AI 修士 in raids, AI 道友, 擂台 AI 陪练) always fights with the legacy Moves.MOVES 御剑-style kit and an AI skin. No AI ever plays 苍鸿's kit (一闪, 回风 parry, 断月 waves). On web (no LAN) and in solo play the player can never fight against, or alongside, the new hero, and the hub 1v1 against AI never exercises the 御剑 vs 苍鸿 matchup the balance targets. SPEC §6.5 kept the AI on the old entries, so this is a completeness gap rather than a violation.
gaps.trigger: Play the web build: every 擂台 match and every 红名 rival is a legacy 御剑-style fighter; 苍鸿's parry and wave matchup can never be practised.
gaps.fix: Next step: let air_foe take a hero_def (chain / moves / kit hooks) and pick a random hero for raid rivals. At minimum, the arena AI should mirror or alternate the player's hero.

gaps.title: No onboarding for the new mode; the only controls help is the legacy cultivation text
gaps.detail: The only in-game controls help is the F1 text, visible only outside compact mode (the 试剑台). It is legacy: '1-8 或 [ ] 切换境界', 'R 大罡剑阵（大乘专属…）', 'E 万剑齐发(需先 Q 召剑)', '结丹起空战', plus the 9-realm strip. Nothing explains the E/Z/Q/R hero skills, 回风 parry or awakening. The extraction rules appear only as one tip line on the 入境页. The hub gives no first-run guidance (no '门 2/3 → 搜箱 → 撤离读条 → 商人卖售卖物' chain), and a new save drops straight into a 初级战场-rule map with 2-stack loss on death.
gaps.trigger: New player in the 试剑台 presses F1 → sees realm-switch and 大乘-only instructions that no longer apply to their hero.
gaps.fix: In hero mode, build the F1 / help text from hero_defs skills plus the shared base kit. On a newly created ex_profile, show a one-time hub hint chain (hub_hall.say / _later) covering the loop, and point at gates 2 / 3 and the 洞府 button.
